jobs.title: IT/AV Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** IT/AV Project Coordinator

**Department:** IT/AV Services

**IT/AV Project Coordinator - Job Summary**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator** to support the successful delivery of **IT infrastructure, low-voltage, audiovisual (AV), unified communications, and technology deployment projects**. This role serves as the primary liaison between clients, internal teams, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to scope.

The ideal candidate has strong experience coordinating multiple projects, conducting **site surveys and on-site project visits**, managing project documentation, tracking schedules, and supporting cross-functional technical teams. Experience within the **IT, AV, structured cabling, low-voltage, or technology integration industry** is highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage multiple IT, AV, and technology projects from initiation through completion.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, internal teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Conduct **site surveys, field assessments, and on-site project visits** to gather requirements, evaluate project readiness, and support successful execution.
* Participate in project kickoff meetings and assist with project planning activities.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, resource plans, and status reports.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, budgets, risks, and action items.
* Coordinate project resources, subcontractors, vendors, and equipment deliveries.
* Monitor project performance to ensure scope, quality, budget, and timeline objectives are achieved.
* Collect, document, and manage business and technical requirements.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project plans, meeting notes, change requests, closeout packages, and final project deliverables.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and support project acceptance processes.
* Facilitate project status meetings and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate end-user training and project handoffs as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in Project Coordination, Project Management, Account Management, or a similar role supporting enterprise technology projects.
* Experience managing or coordinating **IT, AV, audiovisual, low-voltage, structured cabling, network infrastructure, or technology deployment projects**.
* **Required:** Experience conducting **site surveys, field assessments, job walks, and on-site project visits**.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle management, scheduling, documentation, and resource coordination.
* Experience working with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and cross-functional technical teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience tracking project budgets, schedules, deliverables, and project risks.
* PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Medical / Dental / Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

Learn more at **www.gstinc.com**

**Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in IT/AV solutions!**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**About Company:**

**Element U.S. Space & Defense** stands at the forefront of testing innovation, serving as a trusted partner to NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, government agencies, and prominent industry leaders across the space and defense sectors. Founded as NTS Technical Systems, our company brings over 60 years of experience and expertise in handling the most complex projects and programs in the world.

From centrifuge testing for the latest Mars rover, vibration testing for the Space Launch System (SLS), to environmental simulations for next-generation missiles, we are the pioneering partner for highly custom, end-to-end testing design and implementation. By advancing our state-of-the-art testing technologies, subject matter expertise, and service to critical missions, Element U.S. Space & Defense has become the go-to partner for ground-breaking industries.

**What We Offer:**

**Growth & Development:**

* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.
* The chance to work on groundbreaking projects that shape the future of space and defense.

**Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible to participate in the benefits offered throughout their availability, including the following:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts
* Seven (7) paid holidays and four (4) paid floating holidays, depending on your hire date
* Paid Time Off (PTO), accrued biweekly
* 401k with employer match
* Twelve (12) hours of Paid Volunteer Time Off (PVTO) each year
* Tuition reimbursement and other employee programs
* Flexible schedules offered at some of our labs
* Monthly Lab Bonus plans (Based on position)

**Salary:**  
At EUSSD, compensation is determined through a comprehensive approach that considers candidate qualifications, role responsibilities, market benchmarks, and organizational needs. Pay may vary by location; for this position, the annual base salary target range is $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with potential eligibility for bonuses or commission depending on the role.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Manages a book of active customer orders that consists primarily of quick-turn, transactional work. Primarily focused on ensuring production testing is completed on time (speed of completion is a priority). Manages the flow of work within or between departments. Provides the level of customer engagement required by type of project and specific customer to ensure the customer's needs and expectations are met. Acts as a customer service representative and focuses on creating a positive customer experience.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

* Takes complete ownership of projects within book of business. Ownership entails:
* Fulfilling our commitments and customer needs,
* Delivering projects to operations in a timely manner to ensure schedule commitments can be met (CRDs and PDDs),
* Understanding project success means ensuring the project is completed on-time
* Providing customers with the expected amount of communication,
* Coordinating the flow of work through the facility with Customers and Department Managers,
* Consistently using the best practices of project coordination,
* Establishing collaborative and mutually supportive relationship with those responsible for operations,
* Striving to make operations successful.

**CORE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Performs duties for standard work with the use of standard SOPs.
* Ensures production tests are completed on-time.
* Works with operations to expedite testing through the facility.
* Follows standard practices and procedures in managing order book.
* Builds productive internal and external working relationships.
* May be responsible for billing of projects.
* Proactively manages planned subcontracted work (i.e: IJOs and non-EUSSD subcontractors) including setting expectations with the subcontractor and monitoring subcontractor progress.
* With assistance, able to manage unplanned subcontracted work.
* Primarily repeat work (operations as opposed to projects).
* Is primary point of contact for customer questions.
* Usually minimal customer interaction required due to quick timing of testing.
* Communication typically limited to confirmation of receipt/testing (CRD) initiation and test completion (PDD).
* Communicates schedule changes to the customer.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 1 - 3 years' experience. Customer service experience required.
* Must be organized and practice time management.
* Must have strong communication skills to work with different internal partners and customers.
* Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues.
* Basic MS office skills.
* Basic skills in prescribed internal tools (scheduling, ERP, etc.).

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

Test lab with exposure to sudden, loud noises

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; climb stairs; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

**EEO POLICY STATEMENT:**

It is the policy of EUSSD to offer Equal Employment Opportunity to all individuals without regards to race, creed, ancestry, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, physical disabilities, pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions.

Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V

**Job no:** 562875
  
**Work type:** Staff
  
**Location:** Pomona
  
**Categories:** Unit 4 - APC - Academic Professionals of California, Probationary, Full Time, Student Services, On-site (work in-person at business location)

**Type of Appointment:** Full Time, Probationary
  
  
**Job Classification:** Student Services Professional III
  
  
**Anticipated Hiring Range:** $5,540 per month
  
  
**Work Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; schedule may vary based on operational needs and may include occasional evenings and weekends in support of orientation and transition programs.  
  
  
  
**THE DEPARTMENT:**
  
  
New Student Programs and Family Engagement is responsible for preparing entering students for academic and personal success by providing an effective transition to the university from the point of admission through the end of the students' first year. New Student Programs and Family Engagement provides information, communications, and services to incoming students and their support system to orient them to the traditions, mission, philosophy, and culture of the campus and to make them knowledgeable about Cal Poly Pomona's opportunities, resources, challenges, and programs. New Student Programs and Family Engagement designs, plans, implements, and assesses mandatory online and in-person orientation events, as well as the ongoing engagement of family members and supporters throughout the academic year. The position will bring together existing decentralized institutional programs, services and activities for parents and families under one functional administrative structure to ensure optimum coordination and resource management, timely response and referral and identification of additional opportunities to enhance parent/family relations and outreach. New Student Programs and Family Engagement serves as the administrative office for the mandatory student orientation programs, parent/family orientation, and parent/family communication. The office is responsible for compliance with federal, state, CSU System, and University requirements and the timely and accurate dissemination of information to students, parents, families, supporters, and campus constituents. New Student Programs and Family Engagement is housed within the Division of Student Affairs and is part of the Student Experience cluster that reports to the Director of New Student Programs and Family Engagement. New Student Programs and Family Engagement works collaboratively with campus partners in support of enrollment management goals, student success and retention, equity and belonging, and institutional planning efforts. The Division of Student Affairs strives for excellence through a shared student-centered philosophy and values of collaboration, inclusivity, integrity, innovation, and student-centeredness. In performing the duties assigned to this position, the incumbent is expected to consistently demonstrate attitudes and behaviors that are in keeping with the division's philosophy and values.
  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Student Leader Development & Program Leadership

* Coordinate the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of approximately 40 Orientation Captains and Orientation Leaders.

* Evaluate the effectiveness of student-leader training and recommend improvements based on program needs and assessment results.

* Develop program learning outcomes, activities, and assessment strategies that support incoming students' transition to the university.
* Coordinate New Student Convocation, welcome activities, and other transition experiences, including program logistics, campus partnerships, communications, and implementation.

* Research and recommend student engagement activities that support peer connection, belonging, student success, and continued transition throughout the first year.

jobs.title: Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***Starting salaries are set in accordance with our compensation plan, which considers multiple individual and organizational factors, including internal equity. To uphold pay equity in alignment with the compensation plan, starting salary ranges are not negotiable. Before applying, please ensure that the compensation for this position meets your needs.***

**Our Mission**

To promote the well-being of the underserved by providing access to high-quality healthcare for all, regardless of ability to pay.

Our services, activities and governance reflect the Islamic values and moral principles which inspired our founders. These include the core values which are universally shared and revered by society at large: Service, Compassion, Human Dignity, Social Justice, and Ethical Conduct.

**Working at UMMA**

UMMA is looking for passionate and mission-driven Staff who look to make an impact on the lives of our patients and the members of our community. These roles include Physicians and Medical Staff, Behavioral Health Staff, Administration, and more! For more information on the services we provide, Click Here

**Benefits and Compensation**

UMMA offers a competitive compensation and benefits package with comprehensive and cost-effective medical plans. Benefits package includes Medical, Dental, Vision, AD&D and Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program Tuition Reimbursement, loan repayment opportunities, 403(b) savings plan, employee discounts, extended lunch on Fridays, and more!

Our compensation plan also includes Paid Holidays, Paid Time Off (accruals begin on the first day of hire), Employee Recognition, and more!!

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating patient access, scheduling, registration, school-site logistics, outreach, and follow-up activities for the Mobile Optometry Program. This position serves as the primary front-office and patient coordination resource for mobile optometry services and serves as the primary driver and logistics lead for the mobile optometry vehicle.

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator works closely with schools, clinic staff, patients, families, the Optometry Assistant, and the Program Manager to ensure patients are identified, registered, scheduled, prepared, and ready for their optometry services. At school locations, the Program Coordinator serves as the primary onsite liaison with school personnel and coordinates the movement and readiness of students scheduled to receive services. At clinic and community sites, the coordinator organizes patient arrival, registration, waiting areas, and flow into the mobile optometry unit.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**
--------------------

**Patient Scheduling and Registration**

* Coordinate scheduling of patients for mobile and portable optometry services.
* Contact patients and families to schedule or confirm appointments.
* Verify demographic and contact information prior to appointments.
* Obtain or coordinate collection of insurance information.
* Assist patients and families with completion of required registration forms, consents, questionnaires, and other documentation.
* Identify incomplete registration information before scheduled service dates and conduct outreach to resolve outstanding items.
* Coordinate appointment reminders through telephone calls, text messages, electronic systems, or other approved methods.
* Maintain accurate appointment schedules and patient rosters.
* Work to fill cancelled appointments and unused appointment capacity.

**School Coordination**

* Serve as the day-of-service operational contact for school administrators, nurses, teachers, office personnel, and other designated school staff.
* Receive and maintain approved student appointment rosters.
* Coordinate with school staff to identify students who are scheduled to receive services.
* Assist with coordinating students' release from classrooms according to school procedures.
* Escort or coordinate students from designated areas to the mobile optometry service location when appropriate.
* Ensure students are returned to the appropriate school location following completion of services.
* Track students who are absent, unavailable, decline services, or cannot be seen and coordinate rescheduling when appropriate.
* Communicate schedule changes, delays, or operational concerns to school representatives and the Program Manager.
* Protect student and patient privacy when coordinating services in school environments.

**Mobile Site Setup and Patient Flow**

* Serve as the onsite logistics lead for patient arrival and waiting-area operations.
* Establish and organize registration and waiting areas outside the mobile unit when appropriate, including tents, tables, chairs, signage, and registration materials.
* Check patients in and confirm completion of required documentation before entering the mobile unit.
* Coordinate patient flow with the Optometry Assistant to prevent congestion and unnecessary delays.
* Communicate delays and estimated wait times to patients, families, and school personnel as appropriate.
* Assist with setup and breakdown of mobile service locations.

**Outreach and Patient Communication**

* Serve as a primary telephone and program contact for patients and families.
* Answer general questions regarding appointments, mobile service locations, registration requirements, eyeglass delivery, and program processes.
* Conduct outreach to patients who miss appointments or require rescheduling.
* Provide approved instructions regarding where patients should report for services and what documentation they should bring.
* Assist patients with navigating follow-up appointments and other non-clinical next steps.
* Route clinical questions to the Optometry Assistant, licensed optometrist, or appropriate clinical staff.

**Eyeglass and Follow-Up Coordination**

* Track patients requiring eyeglasses or additional follow-up following their optometry examination

jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Surgical Republic | On-site — Southern California**

**About the role:**

Surgical Republic supplies surgical instruments, disposables and implants to hospitals and surgery centers. We are seeking an organized, reliable Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to manage supplier orders and move products accurately from receiving through customer delivery.

You will order from approved U.S. and international suppliers, maintain inventory records, pack and ship orders, and follow up on delays. Our customer-service team handles instrument cross-referencing and provides the approved product specifications and part numbers.

**Responsibilities:**

Purchasing and supplier follow-up

* Place purchase orders using approved suppliers, part numbers, quantities and spending limits.
* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

Inventory and receiving

* Receive deliveries and verify products, quantities and condition against purchase orders.
* Record receipts, stock movements and storage locations accurately.
* Maintain an organized, clearly labeled inventory area.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor approved stock levels and submit replenishment needs.
* Track trial/demo instruments, returns and outstanding loaned inventory.

Order fulfillment

* Pick, check and pack the correct products and quantities.
* Prepare packing slips, shipping labels and required documents.
* Schedule carrier pickups and record tracking information.
* Coordinate partial shipments and backorders with customer service.
* Process approved returns and report damaged or incorrect items.

Order tracking and communication

* Keep the shared order tracker current, including supplier confirmations, delivery dates, blockers and shipment status.
* Notify customer service promptly when an order’s promised date is at risk.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

**How you will work with the team:**

* Hassan, Customer Service: Provides cross-referenced products and approved part numbers; handles customer communication.
* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

**What success looks like:**

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator

**Pasadena, CA | Full-Time**

About Us

We are a busy, independent clinical research site specializing in **hepatology and liver disease clinical trials**, located in Pasadena, California. Our team conducts complex clinical trials across a range of liver diseases and works closely with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors and CROs.

We are looking for an **experienced Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** who will thrive in a fast-paced, highly organized research environment and take ownership of their studies from startup through closeout.

This is an excellent opportunity for a CRC who enjoys being part of a close-knit team, wants meaningful responsibility, and is comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, research staff, sponsors, CROs, laboratories, and vendors.

The Opportunity

The ideal candidate is an experienced CRC who can **hit the ground running**. You should be comfortable managing multiple protocols simultaneously, coordinating patient visits, maintaining regulatory documentation, communicating with monitors and sponsors, and keeping studies on track.

* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities
* Professional and confident communication with sponsors, CROs, monitors, physicians, and patients
* Strong computer skills and ability to learn new research systems quickly

Highly Preferred

* **Hepatology or gastroenterology clinical research experience**
* Experience with liver disease clinical trials
* Experience with **MASLD/MASH, NASH, PBC, PSC, hepatitis B/C, cirrhosis, or other liver diseases**
* Experience with obesity or metabolic disease trials
* Experience with Phase II or Phase III pharmaceutical-sponsored trials
* Experience with complex protocols involving imaging, FibroScan, MRI, biopsies, specialty laboratories, or other specialized assessments
* Experience communicating directly with CROs and pharmaceutical sponsors
* Spanish-speaking/bilingual candidates are strongly preferred

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive** rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Highly organized and able to keep multiple studies moving simultaneously
* Comfortable taking ownership of their assigned protocols
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture
* A strong communicator who is comfortable speaking with physicians, patients, monitors, CROs, and sponsors
* Calm and solution-oriented when problems arise
* Comfortable in a busy clinical environment
* A team player who is willing to help colleagues when needed
* Interested in learning and growing within clinical research

**Engagement:** Part-time, non-exempt employee

**Reports To:** CEO

**Compensation:** The compensation range is $45–$55 per hour, commensurate with relevant experience and qualifications. This is a part-time, non-exempt position. Eligibility for benefits, reimbursements, and other employment terms will be addressed in the applicable offer letter and company policies.

**ROLE PURPOSE**  
Provide dependable, hands-on operational support across the following so Ravanty leadership can stay focused on clients, delivery, sales, and strategic growth:

**1.** People operations

**2.** Bookkeeping

**3.** Office operations

**About Ravanty**

Ravanty Tech Consulting, Inc. is a Microsoft-focused consulting and professional services firm headquartered in Burbank, California. Ravanty supports organizations with Microsoft 365, Copilot, AI governance, security, compliance, cloud solutions, adoption, and change management. The company operates in a fast-moving, client-focused environment where accuracy, responsiveness, discretion, and professional follow-through are essential.

**Position Summary**

Ravanty is seeking a resourceful and highly organized part-time Business Operations Coordinator to support day-to-day financial administration, bookkeeping coordination, people operations, and office administration. This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who is comfortable moving between QuickBooks-related tasks, invoice and expense administration, employee onboarding records, vendor coordination, compliance calendars, and executive follow-up.

The successful candidate will bring structure to recurring operational work, maintain accurate records, identify missing information before it becomes a problem, and follow tasks through to completion. This role is not intended to replace Ravanty’s CPA, payroll provider, legal counsel, benefits broker, or executive decision-makers. The coordinator will prepare, organize, track, and escalate information so those parties and Ravanty leadership can act efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

Responsibilities will be prioritized based on business needs and the approved weekly schedule. The coordinator is not expected to perform every listed activity each week.

* Coordinate payroll inputs, approved compensation changes, deductions, reimbursements, and other payroll-administration items with the payroll provider.
* Assist with monthly close readiness by compiling requested reports, identifying incomplete items, and coordinating follow-up with leadership and the external accountant.
* Prepare recurring management summaries such as open receivables, scheduled payments, payroll changes, subscription renewals, and outstanding financial action items.
* Support project financial administration, including timesheet follow-up, invoice backup, purchase-order tracking, and approved project closeout documentation.
* Follow up on timesheet completion and identify missing or inconsistent entries for review.
* Help compile project status inputs for the purposes of invoicing support, change-order records, and closeout documentation.
* Maintain strict separation between administrative coordination and project-management decision authority unless responsibilities are specifically delegated.

**2. People and HR Administration**

* Coordinate new-hire and contractor onboarding checklists, required documents, background-check steps, equipment requests, and internal introductions.
* Maintain organized personnel and contractor records with appropriate confidentiality and access controls.
* Coordinate employee status changes, benefit-enrollment administration, payroll notifications, and separation checklists under leadership direction.
* Maintain administrative trackers for time off, required acknowledgments, training, certifications, performance-cycle dates, and policy updates.
* Support recruiting administration, including job-posting coordination, candidate scheduling, interview materials, and communication follow-up.
* Coordinate with external HR, payroll, benefits, insurance, or legal advisors when directed, without independently providing legal or HR advice.
* Help maintain current versions of employee-facing policies, templates, onboarding materials, and internal administrative procedures.
* Escalate employee-relations concerns, accommodation requests, complaints, payroll discrepancies, or potentially sensitive matters promptly to the designated executive leader.

**3. Office and Corporate Administration**

* Maintain an organized calendar of business registrations, insurance renewals, professional memberships, licenses, tax notices, annual filings, and vendor renewals.
* Coordinate office supplies, equipment records, shipping, document signatures, meeting logistics, and occasional local errands or in-person administrative support.

jobs.description:
**Who we Are?**

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in our local office. This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

Founded in 1920, C.R. England, Inc. is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT and is one of North America’s premier transportation companies. C.R. England is an industry leader in Dedicated, Over-The-Road, cross-border Mexico, and Intermodal services.

**Position:** Logistics Coordinator

**Summary:**

Logistics Coordinators must be organized and engaged with the team.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities:**  
The Logistics Coordinator key responsibilities are to manage asset utilization and drivers to ensure a high delivery of customer service and fleet profitability. Additionally, the Logistics Coordinator assists, coaches and mentors' drivers with all training and administrative items.

* With team drivers, ensuring loads assigned are appropriate for teams and hours available.
* Monitor Hours of Service for dispatching and compliance.
* In a dedicated training environment, efforts should be focused on routing trucks or drivers (solo) with capacity to a terminal for better efficiency.
* Handle urgent situations such as the need to recover truck, freight, or driver, traffic, weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances that may prevent on-time delivery.
* Assist in orienting new drivers to fleets/accounts on proper ways to communicate, report to work, and other scheduling expectations.
* Work with drivers who have unique scheduling needs or issues that arise. Ensure coordination with supervisors and managers for special items such as leaves of absence, extended time off requests or concerns about meeting expectations.

**Job qualifications may include, but not limited to:**  

* Ability to work with office equipment, utilizing computers for majority of tasks and must be familiar with Microsoft Office suite of programs.
* Proficient with Excel and other reporting capabilities.
* Excellent inter-personal skills with drivers, other personnel, customers, and management.
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.

**Physical Requirements:**  

* Capable of hearing, with or without correction, sufficiently to perceive normal speaking levels and receive detailed information through oral communication in order to facilitate meetings and work with internal customers and stakeholders by telephone and in person.
* Position may involve kneeling, stooping, bending, pushing, lifting, carrying and moving objects that can weigh up to 25 pounds.
* Capable of working extended hours, to include weekends, holidays and various shifts (to include evening and night shifts) as necessary.
* Capable of sitting at a desk for extended periods of time and working with computer equipment.
* Capable of speaking, writing, and reading English well and possessing a good command of the language so that various types of communications may be conducted in English with people of various levels of education and capabilities.
* Capable of visual acuity, with or without correction, sufficient to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, and read extensively.

**Education and Experience:**  

* College degree preferred but combination of college work and experience will be considered.
* Prior logistical or planning experienced needed.
* Transportation or logistics industry experience preferred.
* Strong geographical knowledge with expertise in time and distance requirements as it pertains to Department.
* Transportation regulations is needed.
* High school diploma or GED required.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**SUMMARY**

The Research Coordinator supports the daily research and administrative operations of the laboratory. The position coordinates purchasing, vendor orders, supply inventory, specimen receipt and shipping, laboratory database records, scheduling, communications, and general laboratory maintenance. The Research Coordinator provides administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager and facilitates research-related interactions with collaborators within the Institute and outside centers.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support general research laboratory activities and routine administrative functions.
* Order laboratory supplies and materials; monitor order status; receive vendor items; verify deliveries; and follow up with vendors regarding delays, discrepancies, returns, or other order issues.
* Maintain laboratory supply inventory, monitor stock levels, organize storage areas, and coordinate replenishment to support daily operations.
* Monitor and coordinate the receipt, documentation, routing, storage, and shipment of specimens and research materials received from or sent to outside centers.
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate laboratory item, specimen, inventory, and research data in Microsoft databases and other approved systems.
* Provide administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager, including maintaining records, preparing routine documents, monitoring follow-up items, and assisting with program activities.
* Answer telephone calls, route inquiries, and deliver accurate and timely messages to laboratory members.
* Coordinate the Director’s calendar and meetings, including scheduling, invitations, room or virtual-meeting arrangements, materials, and related communications.
* Organize general laboratory maintenance activities, service requests, shared-space needs, and communications with internal service departments and external vendors.
* Maintain organized administrative, purchasing, inventory, shipping, specimen, and laboratory records in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate research-related communications and interactions with collaborators within the Institute and at external research centers.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of laboratory and research program needs.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in one of the biological sciences or a closely related field required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* More than three (3) years of experience supporting general research laboratory activities and related administrative tasks.
* More than two (2) years of experience in a laboratory administration position.
* Experience ordering, monitoring, and receiving vendor items and communicating with vendors regarding laboratory orders.
* Experience maintaining laboratory supply inventories and supporting general laboratory operations and maintenance activities.
* Experience monitoring and documenting the receipt and shipment of outside specimens or research materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft applications and databases used to manage laboratory items, specimens, inventory, and research data.
* Demonstrated ability to provide administrative support, coordinate calendars and meetings, handle telephone calls and messages, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow tasks through completion.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work professionally with laboratory personnel, leadership, vendors, and internal and external research collaborators.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with laboratory purchasing, inventory, specimen-tracking, shipping, or research-administration systems.
* Experience supporting a research director, principal investigator, program manager, or multidisciplinary research team.
* Experience coordinating with institutional departments, vendors, and external research centers.

jobs.title: Retail Merchandise Coordinator at Angel Stadium
jobs.description:
**LEGENDS GLOBAL**

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world's greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated solution of premium services that keeps our partners front and center through our white-label approach. Our network of 450 venues worldwide, hosting 20,000 events and entertaining 165 million guests each year, is powered by our depth of expertise and level of execution across every component feasibility & consulting, owner’s representation, sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and content & booking of world-class live events and venues.

The Legends Global culture is one of respect, ambitious thinking, collaboration, and bold action. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can be authentic, make an impact, and grow their career. Winning is an everyday thing at Legends Global. We have the best team members who understand every win is earned when we come together as one unified team. Sounds like a winning formula for you. **Join us!**

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:**

The Retail Coordinator / Merchandising Coordinator plays an important role in delivering an exceptional fan shopping experience by supporting the day-to-day merchandising and retail operations at Angel Stadium.

This position is responsible for executing visual merchandising standards, supporting product launches, maintaining retail presentation, coordinating promotional activations, and partnering with store leadership to ensure merchandise is displayed effectively and stores are prepared for every event.

Working closely with the Retail Director, Operations Manager, Warehouse, and Store Managers, the Retail Coordinator helps create engaging shopping environments that drive sales while maintaining brand standards across all retail locations.

This position is ideal for a creative, organized, and energetic individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced retail environment and has a passion for merchandising, retail presentation, and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Visual Merchandising**

* Execute visual merchandising standards across all retail locations.
* Set merchandise displays based on seasonal themes, promotional campaigns, and product launches.
* Maintain store presentation, fixture organization, and product placement to maximize sales.
* Create compelling merchandise displays that enhance the guest shopping experience.
* Ensure promotional signage, pricing, and marketing materials are accurate and properly displayed.
* Assist with window displays, feature tables, and promotional floor sets.

**Retail Operations**

* Support daily retail operations across all stadium retail locations.
* Conduct routine store walks to identify merchandising opportunities and ensure stores meet presentation standards.
* Assist store managers with product placement and merchandising adjustments based on sales trends.
* Coordinate merchandising for Opening Day, postseason, concerts, giveaways, and special events.
* Help prepare stores for new merchandise launches and promotional activations.
* Maintain clean, organized, and guest-ready retail environments.

**Merchandise Planning Support**

* Assist the Purchasing & Inventory team with new product launches and seasonal assortments.
* Provide feedback on merchandise placement, customer shopping behaviors, and product performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and increase sales.
* Support markdown execution and promotional merchandise transitions.
* Assist in setting planograms and merchandising guides.

**Team Support**

* Partner with Store Managers to maintain consistent merchandising standards.
* Assist with training retail staff on merchandising expectations and product presentation.
* Collaborate with Warehouse and Retail Operations to ensure stores remain properly merchandised throughout events.
* Support special projects, store resets, remodels, and new retail initiatives.
* Provide additional operational support during high-volume events as needed.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must be at least 18 years old
* Experience in professional sports, entertainment, hospitality, or high-volume retail environments.
* Experience executing visual merchandising standards across multiple retail locations.
* Experience setting planograms and promotional displays.
* Knowledge of retail sales trends and customer shopping behavior.
* Experience supporting product launches and seasonal merchandising initiatives.
* Ability to interpret sales data to improve merchandise presentation.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to work throughout the stadium, including office, retail, and stockroom environments.
* Ability to walk and stand for extended periods.
* Ability to climb ladders and adjust merchandise displays safely.
* Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull merchandise weighing up to 30 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

**SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and all Angel Stadium events as business needs require.
* Occasional extended hours may be required during Opening Day, postseason, concerts, and special events.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

**Location:** On-Site at Angel Stadium in Anaheim, CA.

**COMPENSATION:**

**Hourly Rate:** $27 Part-Time Seasonal

jobs.description:
**ABOUT OLIPOP**

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

**Role Overview**

The Innovation Project Manager is the operational backbone of the Innovation team, translating ideas and priorities into clear plans, coordinated workstreams, and successful execution.

This role owns project timelines, team tools, cross-functional communication, and operational processes across the innovation pipeline, working independently to keep complex, fast-moving work on track. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and energized by bringing structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving work.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project & Pipeline Management

* Own project plans, timelines, milestones, and action logs for innovation initiatives from concept through launch.

* Lead cross-functional execution across Innovation, Commercial, Science & Medical Affairs, R&D, Brand, Insights, Commercialization, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Sales aligning partners on priorities, owners, and next steps.

* Anticipate risks and dependencies before they affect timing, develop mitigation plans, and escalate only when leadership decisions are needed.

* Own the innovation pipeline tools and launch calendar as the single source of truth for stakeholders.

* Lead and present monthly pipeline updates, highlighting key milestones, changes, risks, and recommended actions.

Team Operations

* Lead weekly Innovation Operations meetings: set agendas, drive decisions, and hold owners accountable for follow-through.

* Build and manage a team dashboard that gives leadership clear visibility into project status, priorities, and risks.

* Assess team capacity and competing priorities, recommend trade-offs, and propose priorities for VP approval.

* Manage the innovation project budget, including vendor costs and POs, and flag variances with recommended adjustments.

* Identify opportunities to improve how the team works, and design scalable templates, trackers, and workflows that are adopted across the team.

Business Support

* Develop and present materials for executive meetings and Stage Gate reviews, building clear narratives that support decision-making.

* Synthesize complex project information into concise updates, clear recommendations, and decision points for senior stakeholders.

* Lead research, competitive assessments, and launch-readiness activities for priority business needs.

* Build a working understanding of OLIPOP's innovation strategy, category trends, and competitive landscape to inform planning and recommendations.

* Innovation projects have clear plans, owners, milestones, and next steps.

* Risks and dependencies are identified early and communicated clearly.

* Stakeholders have reliable visibility to the innovation pipeline.

* Meetings are focused, productive, and followed by consistent action.

* Cross-functional partners feel informed, supported, and clear on expectations.

* Team processes become more efficient without creating unnecessary complexity.

**Position Summary**

The Production Coordinator is responsible for helping manage the daily flow of production from order entry through completion, quality review, and preparation for invoicing and shipment.

This position works closely with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, Shipping, management, and outside vendors to ensure orders are progressing according to schedule, completed accurately, and meet MICHAEL M's quality standards.

The Production Coordinator is expected to maintain clear visibility into active orders, proactively identify delays or discrepancies, and follow through until issues are resolved.

Position Responsibilities

**Production Coordination and Order Management**

* Coordinate daily production orders and ensure orders are progressing according to schedule.
* Track production orders from start to finish and monitor expected completion and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain accurate and timely updates on active orders.
* Identify orders that are delayed or at risk of missing their required delivery date and escalate concerns promptly.
* Prioritize and closely monitor rush orders, special orders, and other time-sensitive requests.
* Communicate with vendors and outside suppliers regarding materials, components, backorders, outstanding items, and rush requirements.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding production issues until they are resolved.
* Coordinate with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, and Shipping to help ensure orders move efficiently through each stage of the process.

**Quality Control and Order Accuracy**

* Inspect finished merchandise for quality, workmanship, condition, and accuracy before products move to invoicing or shipment.
* Review completed merchandise against production orders, invoices, customer requirements, and applicable specifications.
* Verify item numbers, quantities, sizes, metals, materials, pricing, and other relevant order information.
* Confirm that finished merchandise matches the original order requirements and production instructions.
* Identify quality concerns, order discrepancies, missing information, or other issues before merchandise is invoiced or shipped.
* Communicate discrepancies to the appropriate department and coordinate corrections as needed.
* Assist in maintaining consistent MICHAEL M quality and accuracy standards throughout the production and fulfillment process.

**Order Processing and Documentation**

* Assist with order processing, quotes, production documentation, and other order-related requirements.
* Maintain accurate production statuses, notes, expected completion dates, and supporting information within company systems.
* Maintain organized and accurate production, quality control, and order records.
* Ensure relevant production updates and changes are communicated to the appropriate departments.
* Verify that required information and documentation are complete before orders move to the next stage.

**Production Reporting and Issue Resolution**

* Prepare weekly production reports for management.
* Maintain visibility into open orders, overdue orders, upcoming due dates, rush orders, backorders, and orders at risk of delay.
* Identify recurring production delays, bottlenecks, quality issues, or process problems and communicate them to management.
* Work with management and the appropriate departments to resolve production problems and minimize their impact on customer delivery dates.
* Assist with additional production and operational responsibilities as needed.

Core Expectations

Accuracy, attention to detail, reliability, urgency, organization, and consistent follow-through are essential requirements of this position.

The Production Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned orders and follow issues through resolution rather than simply reporting their status. Potential production or quality problems should be identified and communicated as early as possible so corrective action can be taken before they affect the customer.

Qualifications

* 2+ years of experience in production coordination, order management, manufacturing, quality control, operations, purchasing, or a related role preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to inspect products carefully and identify discrepancies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with internal departments, vendors, and suppliers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.
* Experience with ERP, inventory, manufacturing, or order-management systems preferred.
* Jewelry, luxury goods, manufacturing, or related industry experience is a plus, but not required.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients to generate pipeline for the sales organization. This role focuses on outbound and inbound prospecting, initiating executive-level conversations, and positioning Impact’s technology and managed services solutions to address business challenges. The ideal candidate is consultative, metric-driven, and thrives in a fast-paced sales environment. This position partners closely with Account Executives to drive revenue growth and market expansion.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Prospect and qualify new business opportunities through outbound calling, email, and sales engagement platforms
* Initiate and secure meetings with VP- and C-level decision makers while advancing Director-level conversations to executive stakeholders
* Generate a consistent volume of completed and qualified sales meetings to support monthly pipeline targets
* Conduct discovery conversations to uncover business challenges and align Impact solutions to prospect needs
* Collaborate with assigned Account Executives to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities
* Maintain accurate and timely activity, notes, and follow-ups within the CRM system
* Leverage intent data, sales intelligence, and sequencing tools to drive targeted outreach
* Build and nurture professional relationships through consistent, value-driven follow-up communication

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Experience in sales development, business development, or outbound lead generation
* Proven experience with outbound cold calling and high-volume prospecting activity
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage executive audiences
* Experience using CRM systems and sales engagement platforms such as Salesforce, SalesLoft, Outreach, or similar tools
* Ability to understand and articulate business challenges across multiple industries
* Familiarity with IT services, cybersecurity, digital transformation, or technology solutions preferred
* Self-motivated, results-oriented professional with the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment
* Experience leveraging intent data or sales intelligence platforms for targeted outreach is a plus

----------------------

Behaviors define what our core values look like in action. Leaders are expected to model them; teams are expected to live them:

* Innovation: We embrace change because innovation lives outside the comfort zone.
* Passion: We are driven by purpose, fueled by passion, and obsessed with making an impact.
* Honesty: We are fiercely transparent and consistently honest.
* Fun: We fuel work with fun, knowing life's too short for boring.
* Low Ego: We champion ideas over titles, because brilliance knows no rank.
* One Team: We win as a team, we lose as a team, we are one team.

**Compensation**
----------------

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skillset, experience and training, licensures and/or certifications, and other organizational needs.

Impact may offer applicable incentive compensation plans depending on role and/or department.

Full compensation details can and will be discussed with an Impact Talent Acquisition team member at the start of the interview process.

**Benefits We Take Pride In**
-----------------------------

* 5-year Tiffany & Co. Gift Card or Custom Menswear, 10-year Custom Rolex, 20-year $20,000 Check incentive rewards
* Valuable time off with up to 20 days of PTO, 7 Paid Sick Days, 12+ paid holidays, and Paid Parental Leave
* Development and growth opportunities with on-going training & continued education reimbursement
* 401(K) & retirement plans with complimentary financial advisory services
* Comprehensive health, disability, life, dental, and vision plans

For full benefit information, visit https://www.impactmybiz.com/careers/#benefits

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative**

CODAN USA Corporation

**On-Site - Santa Ana, CA**

**Salary Range:** $25-$30 hourly+ commission/incentive opportunity

CODAN USA Corporation is seeking a motivated **Inside Sales Representative** to support continued growth across U.S. hospital, EMS, specialty-care, and distribution markets.

Working closely with the Inside Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager, the Inside Sales Representative will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, supporting distributor growth initiatives, and advancing qualified opportunities through the sales process.

This is a hands-on sales role focused on proactive prospecting, lead qualification, account development, customer and distributor support, opportunity management, and sales administration. The ideal candidate is a results-oriented professional who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, following up with customers, and working collaboratively across Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Quality, and Product Management.

* Conduct proactive outbound prospecting to hospitals, health systems, EMS agencies, ambulatory surgery centers, specialty-care facilities, distributors, and other targeted customer segments.
* Qualify and follow up on sales leads, quotations, product evaluations, sample requests, distributor inquiries, and inactive opportunities.
* Work with Regional Sales Managers to develop new accounts, expand existing customer relationships, and advance opportunities requiring field-sales involvement.
* Identify opportunities to expand product utilization and increase business within key distribution channels, including Medline, Cardinal Health, Owens & Minor, McKesson, Henry Schein, IMA, and regional distributors.
* Support business development efforts across CODAN's product portfolio, including infusion, transfusion, EMS/whole blood, neonatal/pediatric, specialty, and custom products.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and account information, including opportunity stage, estimated annual potential, expected close date, next steps, and activity history.
* Coordinate pricing requests, product information, literature, samples, product evaluations, customer onboarding activities, and internal follow-up required to support sales opportunities.
* Re-engage dormant customers, identify account growth opportunities, and support customer retention and increased product utilization.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and distributors while providing timely and professional communication.
* Collaborate with Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to support customer needs and remove barriers to sales conversion.
* Manage inbound customer and distributor inquiries, including product questions, account requests, order-related questions, and appropriate follow-up.
* Maintain accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and pipeline information within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to support forecasting, reporting, and sales execution.
* Support CODAN's online-store activities, including customer inquiries, order coordination, issue resolution, product updates, and activities involving WooCommerce, Foundry, EDI, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Provide regular sales activity, opportunity, and pipeline updates to the Inside Sales Manager and Regional Sales Managers.
* Support sales campaigns, customer outreach initiatives, product launches, special projects, market research, and other business-development activities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in inside sales, customer service, account management, sales support, business development, or a related commercial role preferred.
* Experience in medical device, healthcare, distribution, manufacturing, or B2B sales preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct outbound prospecting, build customer relationships, and develop new business opportunities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain consistent follow-up and effectively manage sales activities and opportunities.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through on commitments.
* Experience using CRM and ERP systems to manage customer and sales information preferred.
* **Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience preferred.**
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint, and other business applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* Experience working with hospital, EMS, infusion, transfusion, acute-care, or healthcare distribution markets is highly desirable.

**Benefits**

Medical, dental and vision insurance

401(k) with company contribution

Paid vacation and sick time

Paid holidays

Commission/incentive opportunity

and more

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Remote Type:**

**Job Family Group:**

Sales

**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**

Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.

Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.

Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***

Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k - $50k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO & PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Manager**

CODAN USA Corporation

**On-Site - Santa Ana, CA**

**Salary Range:** $90,000-$105,000 base salary + commission/incentive opportunity

CODAN USA Corporation is seeking an experienced **Inside Sales Manager** to develop and lead a high-performing inside sales function supporting growth across U.S. hospital, EMS, specialty-care, and distribution markets.

Working closely with the Director of Sales and Regional Sales Managers, the Inside Sales Manager will be responsible for developing prospecting and account-development strategies, improving pipeline quality, advancing qualified opportunities, and supporting revenue growth through disciplined sales execution and customer engagement.

This is a hands-on sales leadership role that combines team development with direct involvement in business development, customer and distributor relationships, CRM and pipeline management, online-store operations, sales administration, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate is a results-oriented sales professional who enjoys developing people, building customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and creating processes that improve sales performance and customer responsiveness.

* Lead and develop CODAN's U.S. inside sales function, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, training, and evaluating Inside Sales Representatives as the team grows.
* Establish standardized processes for prospecting, lead qualification, account development, quotation follow-up, sample requests, product evaluations, and opportunity management.
* Support Regional Sales Managers by qualifying leads, coordinating account-development activities, and managing the transfer of opportunities requiring field-sales involvement.
* Prioritize opportunities by territory, product category, distributor, customer segment, and revenue potential to maximize commercial impact.
* Develop targeted business-development campaigns for hospitals, health systems, EMS agencies, ambulatory surgery centers, specialty-care facilities, and distribution partners.
* Drive product growth through strategic distributor partners, including Medline, Cardinal Health, Owens & Minor, McKesson, Henry Schein, IMA, and regional distributors.
* Support growth initiatives across CODAN product categories, including Transfusion, EMS/Whole Blood, Cobra Coil, Trauma Flow, IV Administration, Extension Sets, Neo/Peds, and specialty or custom products.
* Establish and maintain Microsoft Dynamics 365 standards for opportunity tracking, pipeline management, activity documentation, forecasting, ownership, and follow-up accountability.
* Review pipeline activity with sales leadership and Regional Sales Managers to identify opportunities requiring pricing, product, engineering, quality, operational, or leadership support.
* Develop programs to reactivate dormant accounts, expand existing customer relationships, increase distributor penetration, and generate new business opportunities.
* Coordinate quotations, product evaluations, samples, customer onboarding activities, and cross-functional follow-up to improve conversion rates and customer responsiveness.
* Develop and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into pipeline health, sales activity, opportunity progression, conversion rates, revenue contribution, and customer engagement.
* Collaborate with Marketing on lead generation, campaigns, customer communications, product launches, and promotional initiatives.
* Support commercial leadership through account research, pricing analysis, forecasting, sales analytics, business intelligence, and special projects.
* Manage assigned customer and distributor relationships while ensuring timely responses to inquiries, issue resolution, customer retention, and account expansion opportunities.
* Oversee inbound sales inquiries and online-store activities, including customer communications, product updates, order coordination, and issue resolution.
* Support sales-order and customer-management workflows involving WooCommerce, Foundry, EDI, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Ensure customer interactions, sales activities, opportunities, account information, and follow-up actions are accurately documented and maintained within company systems.
* Monitor sales performance and key metrics, including pipeline progression, opportunity conversion, new accounts, dormant-account reactivation, distributor growth, evaluation-to-order conversion, pipeline aging, and follow-up responsiveness.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer service, sales operations, or a related commercial role preferred.
* 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, coaching, or team-development experience preferred.
* Experience in medical device, healthcare, distribution, manufacturing, or B2B sales strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to organize sales activity, improve follow-up discipline, develop opportunities, and maintain exceptional customer-service standards.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience using CRM systems to manage leads, activities, accounts, forecasts, and sales opportunities.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint, and related business applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* Experience serving hospital, EMS, infusion, transfusion, acute-care, or healthcare distribution markets is highly desirable.

**Benefits**

Medical, dental and vision insurance

401(k) with company contribution

Paid vacation and sick time

Paid holidays

Commission/incentive opportunity

and more

Pay: $90,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has a long-standing partnership with Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals to offer support for an expanding product portfolio in primary care.

We are seeking a performance driven Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative with strategic problem- solving skills that can collaborate with multiple stakeholders. The Ideal candidate will demonstrate a track record of sales success or related experience, regardless of industry background. Pharmaceutical experience is not required. We are seeking individuals who can quickly make a meaningful impact, leveraging their proven ability to deliver results, build relationships, and adapt in a dynamic environment.

The Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative will achieve sales and activity targets on assigned territories across primary care customers and meet all relevant standards as set by Inizio and Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals leadership.
