jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**

As a **Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from $116,700 – $147,500.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

**What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

**What you’ll Bring**

  

* 5+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent combination of relevant sales experience and demonstrated performance.

Join a sales organization where complex account ownership, technical growth, and customer impact matter. In Platinum, you will manage meaningful business relationships, compete in a sophisticated market, and partner across sales engineering, mobility, wired, indirect, and support teams to solve customer problems. This role is designed for experienced sellers who want more than transactional selling: it offers the challenge of balancing account strategy, service demands, technical solutioning, and new revenue growth. In addition to competitive pay and commission, AT&T offers paid training, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, wellness programs, and career development resources designed to support long-term success.

**Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act**

Candidates with arrest or convictions records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Relevant Material Job Duties for which Criminal History may have a direct adverse, and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the Conditional Offer of Employment:

* Contact with Customers/

jobs.title: Digital Delivery Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.
* Experience building reporting packages or KPI dashboards for an executive audience.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Youth Services RAICES)
jobs.description:
The **RAICES Program Coordinator** will provide gender-specific services to youth who are at risk. The RAICES Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and management of school groups. Will provide supervision to the Youth Engagement Counselors by checking in and supporting group facilitation as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Primary Functions**

* Plan, coordinate, and evaluate gender-specific workshops, recreation and enrichment activities of the on-site and off-site RAICES program in accordance with contract regulations.
* Contact schools to coordinate groups for each cohort (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer Internship)
* Prepare and submit accurate reports as required by program, including monthly program reports to funding sources (DCYF) and the collection of evaluation and demographic data (surveys).
* Develop curriculum on gender specific topics such as healthy relationships, self-advocacy, hygiene, bullying, and others related to the DCYF contact.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to Youth Engagement Counselors, Youth Interns, and volunteers involved in the RAICES program.
* Plan and implement project-based learning and experiential outings and activities to enhance youth learning and skill development.
* Plan outreach and resource events for the community, youth, schools, etc as part of the contract requirement.
* Ensure that all contact requirements are implemented, documented, and met.
* Support a program environment that is learner centered promotes a sense of physical and emotional safety.
* Support positive relationships between staff and youth, and between youth and their peers.
* Conduct case consultations and check-ins with the Youth Engagement counselors.
* Provide resources to youth, schools, families, community, and Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Communicate with school, community, public agencies and parents/guardians of youth.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to youth interns and volunteers involved in the program.
* Ensure all youth completed the intake forms and communicate with youth families to complete.
* Utilize HUBB software to keep track of all youth’s profiles.
* Ensure Youth Engagement Counselors are completing incident reports on HUBB when youth disclose anything that would be reportable and is required to document.
* Provide individual follow-up services and information and referrals to youth as needed and to other MNC youth services and community services.

* Review CMS data and prepare monthly program reports.
* Develops and oversees outreach plan to recruit target population into case RAICES program.

* Monitors school advocacy efforts including school meetings such as parent conferences, IEP meetings, school disciplinary meetings, as necessary.
* Attending meetings with the Associate Director.
* Support the hiring process, selecting, interviewing, and filling out forms required to hire new employees in the department. Also, assist with the onboarding/offboarding of Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

**Secondary Functions**

* Collaborate in the planning and production of community events including Dia de los Muertos, Holiday/Winter break, Black History month, Carnival SF, Spring break, family nights, program graduations and showcase, etc.
* Recruit in kind service providers to implement gender specific activities, cultural enrichment, health and wellness, youth leadership, and other enrichment activities within the program.
* Create partnerships with other organizations.
* Advocate for youth needs, providing referral information, when appropriate to internal and external services based on individual youth needs. Provide individual follow-up services to clients as needed.
* Collaborate with community to coordinate services.
* Represent MNC at appropriate community forums and funder meetings/trainings; maintain superior customer service with funders, staff, collaborating agencies, parents, and youth. Adequately inform, share information, and collaborate with anyone benefiting from the RAICES program.
* Maintain accurate program records and follow reporting procedures. Compile, analyze, verify, and submit data according to the funding schedule and guidelines.
* Participate in weekly staff meetings, 1:1 supervision, and as training courses are offered.
* Ensure team is completing all training, progress reports, and required documentation for program.
* Actively participate in the creation and implementation of a personal staff development plan striving for self-improvement.
* Must be available to participate in late afternoon, evening, and some weekend activities as needed (including Memorial Day Weekend, during school breaks, and MNC events).
* Ensuring that the curriculum, orders, and any required document is updated and completed.
* Collaborate with program staff to identify individual needs and create proactive strategies that foster social-emotional growth and success.
* Provide case consultations and support to staff, ensuring holistic and trauma-informed approaches.
* Maintain accurate program records and submit data in accordance with funding and reporting requirements.
* Attend required team meetings (weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly). Coordinate services with other MNC programs and community partners to ensure smooth referrals and continuity of care.
* Assist with planning and participating in MNC-sponsored community and cultural events.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

* Provide exceptional customer service.

* Always represent the organization in a professional manner.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $20/hr
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

jobs.title: School Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Flexible schedule
* Home office stipend
* Opportunity for advancement

**We Offer**

* Tutu school onboarding and online training
* Sick pay provided
* Positive company culture
* Additional perks are available!

**Job Summary**  
At Tutu School, we look for magic makers. On our team, we want hearts that never stop twirling and minds that thrive on creativity. We require our teachers to have a strong background in dance, great communication skills, and a commitment to our carefully crafted curriculum. Most of all, we want instructors who are invested in nurturing the big dreams of little dancers.However, this position is unique. We are looking for someone to manage, organize, and host monthly events and birthday parties at our two locations: Burlingame and San Bruno.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, host, manage, organize monthly themed parties, as well as, any booked birthday parties following Tutu School's carefully crafted Class Curriculum.
* Take attendance and answer basic questions about class membership and promotions.
* Build rapport and communication with students' families and prospective clients.
* Perform basic retail duties including product restocking and processing sales using a point-of-sale system.
* Maintain organization and cleanliness of the studio, lobby, retail display, and bathroom.
* Communicate effectively with management and administration.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in dancing with a ballet background is strongly preferred
* High school or equivalent is preferred
* Teaching experience is preferred

**About Tutu School**

* Tutu School is a collection of quaint boutique ballet schools that provides a creative dance education experience for children from 6 months to 8 years old.
* It is a place where students are urged to fully exercise their imaginations as well as their bodies, and where we not only focus on teaching children age-appropriate motor skills and the fundamental principles of ballet but also expose them to the world of classical music and the enchanting stories of famous ballets.

**Our Founding Principle**

* Every child should know what it feels like to dance. We exist to make space in children’s lives for confident creativity and the pure joy that comes from finding oneself in music and movement.

**Tutu Principles**

* **Keep Moving**: Keep dancing. Keep twirling. Keep going. Momentum doesn’t generate itself.
* **Exceed Expectations**: Tutu School families have high expectations. We want to leap over them.
* **Mistakes Happen**: Own them. Understand them. Grow from them.
* **Remember Why**: Tutu School exists to make space in the world for creativity and joy.
* **Next Right Thing**: Find it. Follow it. One right thing at a time.
* **Find The Magic**: Always. In everything you do.

*All Tutu School® locations are independently owned and operated by third-party franchisees. Franchisees, not Tutu School Franchises, LLC., are responsible for all hiring and personnel matters at their individual locations.*

jobs.title: MILITARY ACCOUNT LOGISTICS COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
Military Account Logistics Coordinator

BiRite Foodservice Distributors is a third generation, family-owned company offering a Complete Foodservice Solution. We offer unsurpassed service to all areas of foodservice throughout the greater Bay Area and Sacramento. Since 1966 we have focused on being the best foodservice partner in the Bay Area. We remain committed to serving our community with quality products, timely deliveries, and competitive pricing.

The Military Logistics Coordinator is responsible for managing and coordinating logistics activities for our overseas military contract. The person in this position works closely with logistics and operations teams to meet the needs of military clients and delivers high-quality service and accuracy. The Military Logistics Coordinator will report to the Military Sales Manager and Military Customer Service Manager. This position requires a high level of organizational skill and accurate data entry.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Maintain and update shipping logs for current, upcoming and future shipments.  
Process container bookings using a government run booking program.  
Prepare and organize weekly paperwork and labeling documents for warehouse processing.  
Communicate effectively with warehouse staff regarding paperwork and weekly shipments.  
Complete and maintain Bill of Lading documents, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.  
Process invoices and build shipment packets for final departure.  
Coordinate the delivery of merchandise with the Purchasing Department to meet deadlines.  
Communicate efficiently with trucking and shipping line partners.  
Conduct quality checks for products moving through the warehouse.  
Assist Military Sales Manager and Military Customer Service Manager in special projects.  
Other tasks as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements:

1-3 years of experience in international commercial exporting is preferred.  
Proficient in Microsoft Office, G Suite is a must and AS400 is a plus.  
Strong verbal and written communication skills.  
Highly proficient in data entry and 10-key by touch.  
Very organized to meet weekly deadlines and cutoffs.  
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage frequent interruptions.  
Detail oriented with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.  
Team player, able to collaborate effectively under pressure to meet department goals.  
Must be 18 years of age or older.

Physical Requirements:

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.  
Frequently required to use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and telephone keyboard, and talk or hear.  
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus.  
Time Speaking and Listening: 80% - 100%.  
Concentration: Constant.

Work Conditions:

Ability to remain calm and courteous under pressure, navigate tense situations and communicate professionally with persons of all backgrounds.  
Work may be repetitious, stressful and with little time in between calls.  
Will work in a cubicle in close proximity to other Military Department Personnel.  
On occasion may need to enter the warehouse, which can be cold.

Hourly Range: $28.00 to $32.00 per hour DOE

Schedule: Monday to Friday 6:30 am to 3:30 pm

Position: Nonexempt, Full Time

Location: In-Person, Brisbane CA

Benefits:

Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance (after completion of 60-day introductory period)  
Health Savings Account (HSA)  
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)  
401(k) with Employer Matching (after 6 months of continuous service)  
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays

jobs.title: Event & Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing - they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce - where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Event & Community Manager based in Palo Alto to own our West Coast events. This is the founding role for our West Coast events program: you'll build it across the Bay Area and Los Angeles from the ground up, with no existing playbook to inherit and full ownership over how it takes shape. You'll design and run the experiences that bring our customers, prospects, and industry community together, from intimate dinners and executive roundtables to conference presence. You'll also help grow Nectar's community alongside the broader marketing team.

The Bay Area is home base. From Palo Alto to San Francisco, it's where we connect with tech founders, investors, and B2B operators. Los Angeles is where we show up for consumer brands, creators, and agencies. You'll split your time between both and make Nectar a known name in each.

You'll report directly to the marketing leadership team and work closely with sales, customer success, and the founders to make sure every event and community touchpoint ladders up to pipeline, retention, and brand.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Events**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution for Nectar's West Coast event calendar across SF and LA: customer dinners, executive roundtables, happy hours, creator meetups, and conference sponsorships and booths.
* Run account-based event programs with sales: executive dinners and roundtables built around target accounts, with a follow-up plan for every attendee.
* Build a recurring event series in both cities so Nectar has a consistent, recognizable presence in each market.
* Manage budgets, vendors, venues, and logistics in both cities, and build repeatable processes so events scale smoothly as the company grows.
* Partner with sales and customer success on event strategies that generate pipeline and deepen relationships with existing customers.
* Track and report on event ROI (attendance, sourced and influenced pipeline, and customer sentiment), and use that data to sharpen the calendar over time.
* Represent Nectar at West Coast industry conferences and manage on-site logistics, staffing, and sponsor deliverables.

### **Community**

* Support the launch and growth of Nectar's customer and industry community program (e.g., a Slack community, ambassador program, or customer council).
* Help run the content and engagement cadence that keeps the community active: AMAs, office hours, member spotlights, and peer-to-peer discussion.
* Use in-person events to feed the community, turning SF and LA attendees into active members.
* Build authentic relationships with key West Coast customers, creators, and industry voices.
* Identify and cultivate community advocates who can support case studies, referrals, and word-of-mouth growth.
* Feed community insights and feedback back to the product, marketing, and customer success teams.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5-8 years of experience in B2B event marketing, community management, or a hybrid of both, with most of it at B2B SaaS companies.
* A track record of running B2B field and executive events end-to-end, from concept through post-event reporting, that sourced and accelerated pipeline alongside sales.
* Fluency in B2B event measurement: campaign attribution in HubSpot or Salesforce, sourced versus influenced pipeline, and post-event follow-up with target accounts.
* Experience supporting or growing an online or in-person community.
* Based in or near Palo Alto, with working knowledge of the Bay Area and LA event scenes: the venues, the vendors, and the people worth knowing.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in an early-stage environment where processes don't exist yet. You're excited to build them.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple events across two markets without dropping details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a real interest in connecting with people.
* Willingness to travel regularly to San Francisco, Los Angeles, and industry conferences (estimated 20-30%).

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in the social media, marketing technology, or creator economy space.
* Experience marketing to brand, social, or marketing leaders as the buyer.
* An existing network in Bay Area tech and in LA's consumer brand or creator communities.
* Familiarity with community platforms (Slack, Discord, Circle) and event tools (Luma, Bizzabo, HubSpot).
* Prior experience as an early hire at a startup, building a function from zero to one.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and early equity
* Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match
* ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes
* $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees

**For our Palo Alto Office:**

* Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)
* Free lunch in the heart of University

jobs.title: Field Marketing & Community Manager
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Together AI is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build and scale our account-based field and in-person community programs across priority markets.

This role will be responsible for developing the strategy, audience, format, and execution of high-impact field programs designed to engage priority accounts, accelerate pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and build authentic technical community.

You’ll own programs end-to-end, from identifying the right accounts and developing the event concept to driving attendance, managing the attendee experience, partnering with Sales on follow-up, and measuring business impact.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can pair strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You should be just as comfortable building an ABM event strategy with Sales as you are selecting a venue, shaping an agenda, managing a vendor, or reviewing the attendee list the day before an event.

### **Responsibilities**

#### **ABM & Account-Based Events**

* Develop and execute an ABM event strategy aligned to priority segments, accounts, pipeline goals, and sales priorities.
* Develop repeatable account-based field programs for priority accounts and segments, including dinners, roundtables, customer gatherings, and other targeted regional programs.
* Partner closely with Sales to identify the right accounts, stakeholders, and moments in the buying cycle for each program.
* Own account targeting, invitation strategy, registration goals, attendance conversion, and post-event follow-up plans.
* Ensure every program has a clear business objective and defined next step for participating accounts.
* Evaluate program performance based on account engagement, pipeline creation and acceleration, POCs, opportunities, and other meaningful business outcomes.

#### **Community Programs**

* Build and scale Together AI’s community event strategy across key markets.
* Develop meetups, technical gatherings, workshops, partner programs, and other formats that bring together developers, researchers, AI practitioners, customers, and ecosystem partners.
* Partner with DevRel, Research, Product, Engineering, and other technical teams to develop programming that is genuinely useful and relevant to the audience.
* Identify opportunities to partner with customers, investors, technology partners, startups, and community organizations to extend reach and credibility.
* Build repeatable playbooks while ensuring programs still feel authentic to the local community.

#### **End-to-End Program Ownership**

* Own programs from strategy through execution, including concept development, audience strategy, venue sourcing, budget, vendors, registration, attendee communications, run-of-show, onsite execution, and follow-up.
* Manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining a high bar for quality and attendee experience.
* Partner with the broader Events team to support select third-party conferences and industry moments where field, community, or account-based activation can extend the impact of Together AI’s presence.
* Partner with Creative and Brand on event identity, environmental design, signage, swag, and other experience touchpoints.
* Develop clear event briefs, timelines, budgets, staffing plans, and cross-functional workbacks.
* Own vendor relationships and negotiate contracts to maximize quality and efficiency.
* Travel as needed to support programs onsite.

#### **Measurement & Optimization**

* Partner with Marketing Ops, Demand Gen, and Sales to ensure programs are properly tracked through Salesforce and our event technology stack.
* Build consistent pre- and post-event reporting that shows who attended, account engagement, pipeline impact, and follow-up status.
* Conduct post-event retrospectives and turn learnings into stronger future programs.
* Use data and qualitative feedback to recommend where we should invest more, change approach, or stop investing.

### **Requirements**

* 5–7+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, ABM, or a related B2B technology marketing role.
* Experience developing and executing account-based programs in close partnership with Sales.
* Strong understanding of how events can support pipeline creation, acceleration, customer expansion, and relationship development.
* Experience creating community or experiential programs for technical audiences.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple complex programs at once.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for attendee experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively across Sales, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, DevRel, Research, Creative, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders.
* Comfortable using Salesforce and event/marketing technology to track performance and business impact.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on expected impact, not simply volume of requests.
* High agency and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity.
* Ability to travel up to 30–40% based on event schedules, including international travel.

### **About Together AI**

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

### **Compensation**

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $170,000 - $195,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. I

You will provide work direction to project execution teams that may include Engineers, Designers, Technicians, Project Coordinators, Estimators, and Subcontractors, ensuring that assigned projects are completed accurately, on-time, billed, within budget, and within the scope of the contract. Ensure that work performed complies with state, local, and Federal legal requirements while upholding the highest ethical standards. You will adhere to and ensure that Johnson Controls staff and subcontractors adhere to all safety standards, following consistent and repeatable project management procedures and processes. Maintain an effective balance between customer satisfaction and project financial results.

**How you will do it**
======================

Ensure that Johnson Controls resources and our subcontractor/vendor resources are adhering to the site/JCI safety policies, whichever is more stringent.

Manage the scope, costs, resources, and risks on assigned projects to deliver projects on time and within budget.

Act as the primary on-site leader for execution teams on assigned projects. Develop a Project Execution Plan, including but not limited to Work Breakdown Structure, Organizational Chart, Safety Plan, Project Schedules, Issues/Risk Logs, and Staffing Requirements to execute projects according to plan.

Evaluate the contractual scope of work and the impact of client issued instructions/notices, field directives, and/or project schedule changes. Actively pursue change orders for said changes and additional opportunities. Perform associated cost estimates, prepare proposals, and negotiate final settlement prices as well as customer acceptance.

Manage project-related accounts payable, billing, and collections. Complete project billing with the assistance of the project coordinator in a timely and accurate format to the client to maintain positive cash flow.

Review and interpret contract Terms and Conditions to ensure work is completed to customer satisfaction and JCI standards.

Analyze financial reporting systems and project schedules to proactively address potential problems. Effectively communicate project progress, issues, and financial status to management as required.

Manage risks and establish project recovery plans when required. Resolve disputes with minimal need for escalation.

Prepare RFPs, negotiate, and issue subcontracts.

Ensure project document controls comply with contract requirements and JCI standards.

Oversee project construction for compliance with specifications, local codes, and installation techniques.

Manage the selection, ordering, and delivery schedule of materials to be procured for the projects assigned.

Develop and maintain viable long-term relationships with customers, consultants, prime contractors, and subcontractors. Attend job progress meetings as required. Ensure subcontractors understand project expectations.

Coordinate with the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Construction Manager for allocation of resources needed to meet project objectives. Ensure any engineering and commissioning performed by the field team is in accordance with established standards. Facilitate escalation of product-related problems.

Assist Installation/Operations Manager and/or sales in project development efforts.

Provide feedback on the performance of Engineers and Designers to Engineering and Design Team Leaders as well as Operations Management.

Perform Installation to Service turnover toward the end of every project.

**What we look for:**
=====================

Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or Architecture is preferred. An Associate degree with equivalent work-related experience and/or a minimum of five years of direct field experience in the Building Construction Industry is required.

Must have the ability to verbally and non-verbally communicate technical material to both a technical and non-technical audience. Travel may be required based on project assignment and needs. Must be proficient in Project Management software and financial accounting systems. Experience working with MS Project, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Adobe Writer, Visio, and basic Windows environment.

Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred.

**HIRING SALARY RANGE:** $87,800-$120,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package.

---------------

A Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with AWS high-value strategic customer. Key aspects of the role include:

* Strategic Account Planning: creating and executing long-term account strategy that span quarters (not weeks), aligning cross-functional resources e.g. sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Full time • San Francisco, CA • $80K – $90K base • $130K – $160K OTE**

Parameter builds AI agents that do offensive security work. Our agents run autonomous penetration tests against production applications and cloud environments, finding IDORs, broken access control, XSS, and infrastructure misconfigurations that scanners miss and that human pentest firms only look for once or twice a year.

We are not a theoretical security company. Our team has responsibly disclosed real, high-severity vulnerabilities to well-known technology companies, and our findings are the front door to most of our customer relationships.

Our best conversations start the same way: we find something real in a prospect's environment and tell them about it. You'll own the top of that funnel. That means researching accounts, working with the security team on what we found, and writing the outbound that makes a CISO reply within the hour.

This is not a role where you read a script into a dialer. The people you're emailing break software for a living and can tell within one line whether you understand their problem. You'll need to learn enough security to be credible: what an IDOR is, why broken access control is the thing that keeps them up, and why a once-a-year pentest doesn't cover a codebase that ships daily.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own outbound to security and engineering leaders: build the account list, write the sequences, and run the follow-up
* Turn our vulnerability research into first meetings. When we find something real, you're the reason the right person hears about it
* Book and prepare qualified calls for the founders, and sit in on them until you're running discovery yourself
* Keep the CRM honest. Clean data, accurate stages, and a pipeline number nobody has to caveat
* Close the loop on messaging. Tell us which lines land, which segments convert, and what we should stop saying

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 1+ years of outbound sales development, ideally into technical buyers, or a track record that makes the case some other way
* You write well. Short, specific, and free of the phrasing every other vendor in their inbox is using
* Genuine curiosity about security. You do not need a background in it, but you do need to want one
* Comfort with rejection and with volume. The job is a lot of activity and a small number of very good conversations
* You build your own leverage: research workflows, enrichment, automation, whatever gets you more at-bats without more hours
* Bonus: sold into security or developer tools, worked at an early-stage startup, or hold a security certification

**Interview process (3 rounds)**
--------------------------------

* Intro call with a founder (30 minutes)
* Written exercise and mock call (10 minutes)
* Paid work trial (1 day)
* References and offer

You'll have the founders on your calls, the research team feeding you reasons to reach out, and a product that proves itself in the first engagement. We move quickly and aim to make an offer within two weeks of first contact.

*This role is onsite in San Francisco. You must be authorized to work in the US; we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.*

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

If you enjoy working outdoors in a professional and safe environment, consider a career with Bartlett Tree Experts! At Bartlett, we value a strong culture of excellence in safety, scientific research, lifelong learning, and career development.

  

Bartlett Tree Experts is currently seeking a full-time Arborist Representative to join our growing team. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for arboriculture and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge to establish positive client relationships. As an Arborist Representative, you will play an integral role in helping grow our business by developing and maintaining long-term client relationships. You will be responsible for visiting client properties, assessing their tree and shrub care needs, and providing scientific tree and shrub care recommendations.

**Benefits**
------------

We offer competitive compensation, as well as:

* **Salary:** $70,000-$125,000 plus commission
* A safety-first culture and professional workplace
* Base salary plus commission and bonus plan
* Advancement opportunities - we promote from within
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401k retirement plan
* Paid time off and holidays
* Industry credential/license pay increases
* Company-paid uniforms, car, and cell phone
* Access to training, continuing education programs, and a variety of resources provided by the Bartlett Tree Experts Research Laboratories

To find out more about what life is like at Bartlett, check us out on Instagram @LifeatBartlett.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Responsible for all areas of sales within a defined territory, including selling, marketing, customer service, administration, production, and training
    
  + Meet with existing and potential residential and commercial clients daily to evaluate their tree and shrub care needs
  + Establish, develop, and maintain positive business and client relationships within the defined territory
  + Prepare and provide proposals to clients utilizing sales process tools, software, and other technologies
  + Supervise work to be performed, ensuring jobs are completed based on the signed contract and to the client's satisfaction
  + Set up personal sales expectations with immediate supervisor and prepare to meet sales goals
* Responsible for implementing and enforcing all safety, transportation, and pesticide compliance programs

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 1-3 years of related experience in the tree care industry or prior sales experience
* ISA Arborist Certification or ability to obtain – we will pay for the cost of the exam and help you prepare!
* Ability to learn to identify trees and shrubs common to the region, diagnose pests and diseases, and recommend corrective action or proactive management plans
* Valid driver's license
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Degree in Arboriculture, Forestry, Horticulture, Turfgrass, Environmental Science, Plant Science, Outdoor Recreation, Agriculture or a related field is preferred but not required
  

*The F. A. Bartlett Tree Expert Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)- SF
jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.  
  
Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.

**About Stuut**  
Stuut is transforming accounts receivable for old-school B2B companies—making collections smarter and faster for companies that historically relied on paper checks and spreadsheets. Our platform is gaining traction with finance teams across industrials, chemicals, and manufacturing sectors from Fortune 10 brands to scaling midmarket. We're backed by top-tier investors including a16z, Khosla, Activant, 1984 Ventures and Page One.

**The Role**  
We’re hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to create demand for Stuut’s platform and guide prospects through their first interactions with our product. You’ll work closely with sales, marketing, and leadership to build a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuel Stuut’s growth.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves building relationships, and is excited to set the foundation for Stuut’s go-to-market success. As one of the first members of this team, you’ll help define the gold standard for how we engage prospects and represent our brand.

**What You’ll Do**

* Prospect and qualify leads through high-volume outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn.
* Make 120 cold calls a day and write 40 + outbound emails.
* Conduct discovery conversations and tailored product demos that address each prospect’s specific business challenges.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline in HubSpot, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting.
* Develop account strategies to expand revenue and usage within mid-market customers.
* Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
* Represent Stuut at industry events, webinars, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand presence.
* Provide feedback to product and marketing teams to refine messaging, features, and go-to-market strategy.

**You Might Be a Fit If You…**

* Have an ownership mentality and are eager to take on responsibility.
* Are curious and love to learn in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Communicate effectively across phone, email, and in-person conversations.
* Excel at building authentic connections and collaborating with teammates.
* Have experience in high-growth environments where priorities shift quickly.
* Are motivated to help build a great company and make customers successful.

**Compensation**

* Top-of-market salary and equity package
* Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)
* Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you
* 401(k) & Match
* Equity
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave

**Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

jobs.title: Sales Representative, End User
jobs.description:
**Sales Representative, End User**

  

**Location:** **Northern California (preference for San Francisco, CA or Sacramento, CA areas)**

  

ASSA ABLOY is a global leader in door opening solutions dedicated to providing a safe, secure, and accessible building environment. Every day, we help billions of people move through a safer, more open world with ease. If you’ve ever walked through an automatic door, stayed in a hotel, or gone through passport control, you’ve probably used one of our products or services. ASSA ABLOY’s offerings include products and services related to locks, doors, gates, and entrance automation such as controlling access and confirming identities with keys, cards, tags, mobile and biometric identity verification systems, mechanical and digital locks, cylinders, security doors and automated entrances.

  

Are you as passionate as we are in servicing our customers in the healthcare, school, university, military, and commercial building setting? We provide unsurpassed security and life-safety solutions and the essential support services (LEED consultation, code compliance, access control system integration, product research and selection, specification writing services, technical support, etc.) to ensure well-functioning doorway systems in the commercial building industry. jobs.title: SPD Assistant Project Manager | High End Residential GC
jobs.description:
**Join MatPel Builders as a Assistant Project Manager and help shape some of the most stunning homes in the Bay Area.**

MatPel Builders is a premier general contractor based in the San Francisco Bay Area, specializing in architecturally significant, high-end residential construction. Our portfolio includes modern custom homes, historic renovations, complex remodels, and structural retrofits, each reflecting exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and close collaboration with our clients and project partners.

The Special Projects Division (SPD) is a dynamic and essential part of MatPel. Built on a commitment to exceptional client service and operational excellence, SPD provides continued care for our portfolio of completed homes while managing service and maintenance work, warranty projects, and small to medium-sized renovations. Through these relationships, SPD also creates opportunities for referrals, repeat business, and new project development.

The SPD Assistant Project Manager supports the full project lifecycle, from responding to new project inquiries and evaluating business development opportunities through preconstruction, estimating, execution, and closeout. Working under the direction of the SPD Manager within the Project Management department, the APM develops scopes of work, budgets, and schedules; coordinates with clients, trade partners, and internal teams; and helps manage projects through completion while maintaining established budgets, schedules, and quality standards.

This role requires someone who can effectively manage multiple active projects, service requests, and evolving client needs while delivering a consistently high level of responsiveness and customer service. The SPD APM will also contribute to the continued growth of the division by building strong client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and supporting referrals and repeat business.

Success in this position requires strong organization, communication, judgment, and follow-through, along with the ability to shift between immediate service needs and longer-term project and business development priorities.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES – Project Lifecycle**

**Estimating & Business Development**

* Support and/or lead the business development process with input from the SPD team.
* Identify project phases, details, existing conditions, and requirements that may present potential problems.
* Communicate SPD processes and project requirements to Clients, Architects, Subcontractors and Field Personnel.
* Prepare and/or review estimates with input from Field Personnel.
* Generate and distribute subcontractor walk invitations, and facilitate project job walks.
* Lead or support the subcontractor selection process.
* Develop and/or review the initial project schedule.
* Prepare, review, and approve service, maintenance, warranty, and construction pricing as appropriate.
* Ensure estimates accurately reflect project scope, anticipated requirements, and subcontractor work.

  

**Contract Administration & Project Set-Up**

* Prepare, review, and administer Service Agreements, contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
* Complete project setup documentation and coordinate with accounting to establish project numbers.
* Review the final project budget with the SPD team.
* Confirm subcontractors and coordinate project startup and scheduling.
* Maintain familiarity with all phases and terms of project contracts, estimates, and subcontracts.
* Attend and/or lead preconstruction meetings, site walks, and vendor meetings as required.
* Compile and maintain the project directory.
* Procure and/or coordinate required permits.
* Ensure the project is properly organized and prepared prior to the start of construction.

  

**Project Management & Construction**

* Manage and/or support the project from initial pricing through completion.
* Ensure project scope, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements are actively monitored and managed.
* Maintain and update the project schedule and communicate schedule information to the project team.
* Communicate regularly with the Site Superintendent/Foreman and SPD team.
* Attend and/or facilitate jobsite, OAC, and project meetings as required.
* Facilitate communication between Clients, project team members, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate material ordering, pickup, delivery, and long-lead-time items with the Site Superintendent/Foreman.
* Plan and facilitate the shop drawing and submittal process.
* Assist with subcontractor scheduling and coordination.
* Provide cost and financial information to the project team.
* Maintain complete and well-organized project documentation, including contracts, schedules, change orders, submittals, RFIs, invoices, and other pertinent information.
* Maintain project folders, binders, and electronic documentation.
* Create, review, process, and track change orders, submittals, and RFIs.
* Review subcontractor change orders and prepare them for Client approval as required.
* Auditing of monthly invoices for accuracy and submit them to the Client for payment.
* Review and monitor project budgets, cost tracking, cost projections, and overall job status.
* Identify and communicate project risks, potential issues, and required decisions in a timely manner.
* Ensure key project decisions and contract changes are clearly communicated and documented.
* Administer contract documents and take appropriate steps to identify and mitigate project risk.

  

**Scheduling & Field Coordination**

* Coordinate project meetings, appointments, site visits, and other scheduled activities.
* Send calendar invitations to appropriate project participants and ensure Clients and project stakeholders are aware of scheduled visits.
* Work closely with the Site Superintendent/Foreman to coordinate subcontractor activities and material deliveries.
* Assist with the weekly labor schedule (SIP) for SPD field employe

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Executive Assistant to support our CEO, a senior psychologist and forensic neuropsychologist whose practice centers on assessment and testifying in court as an expert witness. In this role, you will be the person who makes a demanding clinical and executive schedule work — protecting time, anticipating needs, coordinating schedules, developing relationships with multiple medical groups, attorneys, and others, ensuring compliance with license/certification renewal, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks. jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Digital Skilling Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Description: **Who We Are:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) is the nation's premier Latino nonprofit membership organization. Founded in 1990, HF supports Hispanic families and strengthens Latino institutions through grantmaking and direct services in the areas of education, health, immigration, civic engagement, economic empowerment and the environment. Values that drive our work include equality, fairness, diversity, and empathy.

Technological advancements are changing the workforce requirements of our economy. According to Brookings, nearly two-thirds of all new jobs created since 2010 required either high or medium level digital skills. Latinos make up 18% of the overall U.S. labor market and account for approximately one out of every two new workers entering the workforce in 2025 but also make up 35% of workers with no digital skills; 20% of those with limited skills; and only 8% of all STEM jobs. Hispanic Federation's Digital Skilling Program seeks to address these issues through community-based workforce development and technology trainings.

  

**Who we seek:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) seeks a Digital Skilling Program Coordinator to help manage and contribute to HF’s Workforce Initiatives programmatic efforts aimed at increasing the financial security of Latino families. Under the supervision of the Workforce Initiatives Program Manager, the coordinator will be instrumental in supporting administrative and reporting duties for a technology program running three (3) cycles a year at three (3) locations within New York City. The coordinator will learn the intricacies of community outreach, workforce development, program management, technology training programs, digital adoption programs, and poverty reduction efforts.

  

The successful candidate is detail-oriented and has experience and interest in technology training programs, workforce development, and nonprofits. The position requires a high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to increasing workforce development opportunities to underserved communities.

  

**Position Location:** New York, NY

**Reports to:** Workforce Initiatives Program Manager

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming and active program participants providing guidance through the entire program lifecycle and tracking attendance and engagement
* Coordinate day-to-today logistics across site locations for program cycles
* Weekly travel within New York City to the Bronx, Queens and Manhattan
* Prepare, organize, and update digital and physical course materials and cohort schedules
* Administer, distribute, and collect mid-cohort and closeout evaluation surveys; organize qualitative feedback and quantitative ratings into summary decks
* Travel nationally once a year to participate in a train-the-trainer program
* Manage regular communication with program leadership and stakeholders to provide updates on program health, and/or additional support
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely program activity reports
* Ensure compliance with all reporting requirements and prepare programmatic reports
* Serve as point of contact to other program service providers, grantees, and consultants, monitoring performance, funding, and payments
Complete additional tasks as assigned  

  

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a bachelor's degree and demonstrated knowledge of non-profit programs and services within underserved low-income communities preferably centered around digital equity and workforce development
* At least one (1) year of professional experience in administration, logistics, adult education and / or program management
* Excellent technology skills; experience with Office 365, conference platforms, and third-party databases
* Efficient, detail-oriented and organized
* Ability to multi-task and balance assignments from more than one staff person
* Strong, well-developed verbal and writing skills
* Exceptional ability to work with others and develop trust with partner agencies, staff and program participants
* Commitment to Hispanic Federation's mission and core values
* Willingness to learn new technology programs, including AI tools and the Swift Programming Language
* Familiarity with Apple products and systems is a plus, but not required
Fluency in written and spoken Spanish is a plus, but not required  

  

**Compensation**

The salary for this position is $55,000. Compensation includes fully subsidized medical, dental, vision insurance accessible on first day of employment; access to flexible spending for medical and transportation; and a 403 (B) retirement plan with a company match after 6 months of service.

**To Apply**

Please submit a résumé and cover letter detailing your interest and qualifications via the dedicated link. No telephone calls or emails will be accepted regarding this position. Only specific candidates will be contacted regarding their application for this role.

Hispanic Federation is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against actual or perceived race, color, religion, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, creed, disability, marital status, sexual orientation and/or other protected categories.

For more information about the Hispanic Federation, go to www.hispanicfederation.org.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Medical Communications
jobs.description:
Are you a recent college grad or professional looking to transform lives through medical communications? Are you ready for a rewarding career in a collaborative and growing environment? We're hiring a savvy **Program Coordinator** passionate about keeping projects on task and their team focused.

**About You**

* You are flexible and confident you can manage up to 20 projects at a time and be responsible for the project development process.
* You are solution-oriented and can anticipate potential workflow obstacles and provide solutions.
* You're highly organized, a self-starter with an eye for the details and a pulse on the bottom line.
* You flourish in fast-paced environments and relish the particulars.
* You work passionately, never satisfied with the status quo.
* You're a born problem-solver and enjoy when no day is the same.

**Your Day-to-Day**

As a Program Coordinator, you will track project deliverables through all departments, ensure due dates are relayed, and obstacles are identified and communicated efficiently. You will be responsible for running your clients medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) process. This includes submissions, coordinating with taggers, and communicating status updates to the client, the MLR Supervisor, and your supporting team. In addition, you will oversee coordinating internal and external meeting, taking meeting notes during meetings, and providing status updates to the team.

Under supervision from a program manager, you will review invoicing documents and final reconciliations, prepare Sunshine Act reports and any ancillary reports as required by the client. You will work closely with the logistics vendor to perform meeting planning tasks, including site search, venue contracting, travel arrangements, food/beverage, and AV equipment. You will be responsible for preparing and distributing the assignment report and facilitating assignment team meetings.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree, ideally with a concentration in advertising, marketing, communications, or journalism; other majors will be considered
* 0-2 years of prior work experience in a client service/agency setting or related internship experience
* A high level of computer competency and intermediate or advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, and Outlook)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Helpful Experience**

* Working knowledge of timeline and schedule development
* Experience supporting a project manager or marketing team with coordinating tasks and tracking deadlines

**Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. Our proven track record of long-tenured relationships with major pharmaceutical companies and leading bio-tech firms, and our inclusive, open-minded team culture are industry leading. This passionate work environment, paired with growth opportunity, professional development, compensation, and benefits, are why Precision AQ - Medical Communications was recognized as a Best Place to Work by the Philadelphia Business Journal for the last three years.

Are you ready to join a team committed to providing the best in science and strategy?

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

**Recruitment Fraud Warning:** Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process.
