jobs.title: Part-Time Sales & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Manhattan Fencing Center is looking for a friendly, organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Part-Time Sales ,Billing & Operations Coordinator to join our NYC team. The main focus of this position will be new client sales, lead management, and follow-up. You will communicate with prospective clients by phone, email, and text, help them understand our programs and pricing, schedule visits and lessons, and consistently follow up with leads.

We are looking for someone with excellent phone etiquette and communication skills who can provide a warm and professional first impression of our business.

This is a varied role, and we are looking for someone who is willing to learn our entire system, take direction, and help wherever needed. As you learn the business, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities, projects, and hours.

Schedule

* **Saturday:** Approximately 8:30 AM–3:00 PM, in person at our NYC location
* **Monday, Wednesday & Friday:** Approximately 11:00 AM–1:00/2:00 PM; days are flexible and may be remote or in person
* Approximately **10–16 hours per week to start**
* Opportunity for additional hours for the right candidate

**Saturday in-person availability is required.** This is not a fully remote position. Preference will be given to candidates who have additional flexibility to work in person and provide occasional coverage in NYC when needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Respond to new client inquiries by phone, email, and text
* Make outbound calls and consistently follow up with prospective clients
* Help convert leads into trials, private lessons, programs, and memberships
* Learn Manhattan Fencing Center's programs, schedules, pricing, and policies
* Learn and become proficient in Mindbody, including scheduling, client management, and billing
* Process client payments and assist with billing-related questions
* Review accounts for outstanding balances and follow up when necessary
* Assist with package purchases, memberships, and account updates
* Schedule appointments and help families select the appropriate program
* Track leads and ensure no potential client falls through the cracks
* Follow up with prospects throughout the sales process
* Help promote and fill new classes and programs
* Maintain accurate client, lead, and billing information
* Assist with administrative and day-to-day operational tasks
* Provide project-management support for Youth Give Fencing (YGF), our nonprofit organization
* Assist with marketing, outreach, and other projects as needed
* Provide occasional in-person coverage when available

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

* Reliable, personable, and professional
* Extremely organized and detail-oriented
* Excellent at follow-through and staying on top of multiple leads
* Comfortable speaking with prospective clients by phone
* Confident communicating with parents and families
* Able to learn new systems and processes quickly
* Comfortable taking direction and applying feedback
* Proactive and able to eventually work independently without constant reminders
* Interested in sales, customer service, and helping grow a business

**Sales, customer service, administrative, or front-desk experience is preferred.**

Experience with **Mindbody is a plus, but not required**. We will train the right person.

Pay: From $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 16.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape.

The Digital Marketing Coordinator supports the day-to-day website content management, digital publishing, email marketing communications, event microsite configuration, client communications, and related digital marketing workflows.  
The coordinator will be expected to take ownership of assigned work, contribute as part of a collaborative team, and develop increasing independence as their knowledge and experience grow.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Website Content Management**

* Manage and publish website content, including attorney biographies, practice and industry content, events, publications, client alerts, and news.
* Perform quality assurance reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, accessibility, and adherence to brand standards.
* Troubleshoot content display, formatting, and publishing issues.
* Follow content governance and brand standards in all ongoing website maintenance activities.
* Make minor HTML and CSS adjustments as needed to achieve the desired formatting.
* Handling all website content management-related tasks and becoming increasingly independent as experience is gained.

**Email Marketing & Event Campaign Support**

* Configure, test, and deploy email- and event-marketing campaigns using established processes, templates, and quality-control procedures.
* Create and update registration forms, landing pages and microsites, invitation-, reminder- and follow-up emails associated with standard and virtual event campaigns.
* Execute campaign-related automation tasks, including audience filtering, list segmentation, quality assurance testing, trigger and variable management, and deployment.
* Support campaign reporting and digital communication best practices.

**Digital Marketing Technology**

* Support ON24 webinars, including scheduling, configuration, end-to-end testing, presenter and organizer assistance, and escalation of technical issues to the vendor when appropriate.
* Support the administration of email marketing, CRM, webinar, analytics, and other digital marketing platforms.
* Support additional digital marketing projects as needed, e.g., configuration of no- or low-code conference mobile apps using Fliplet.

Through preventive services, foster care, behavioral health, residential programs, education, and community-based supports, we help children and families thrive.

We are seeking a **dynamic, relationship-oriented Outreach Coordinator** to expand awareness of JCCA’s programs, strengthen community partnerships, and develop referral opportunities across our child welfare and behavioral health services.

This is a highly visible, community-facing role for someone who enjoys **building relationships, connecting people and organizations to resources, and creating partnerships that make a difference.** The Outreach Coordinator will serve as an ambassador for JCCA, developing relationships with schools, healthcare providers, community organizations, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders throughout New York City, with a particular focus on the **Bronx and Brooklyn**.

### **Summary of Responsibilities**

**Build Community Partnerships**

* Develop and maintain relationships with community organizations, schools, healthcare providers, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders.

**Community Engagement & Referral Development**

**Program Promotion & Outreach Coordination**

* Collaborate with program and communications teams to promote JCCA’s services and community resources.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, Public Health, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the company**

Jay Franco is a New York-based licensed home textile company. We design and develop bedding, bath, and home products featuring brands like Disney, Marvel, Star Wars, LEGO, and Minecraft, and we sell them to major U.S. retailers including Walmart and Target. Every product starts as artwork and a spec sheet and ends up on a store shelf — and the Product Development Coordinator is the person who keeps dozens of those products moving between our design team, our overseas agents and factories, testing labs, licensors, and retailers, without a detail getting lost on the way.

**What you'll own**

You'll run 20+ active product programs at a time — more in peak season. For each one, you are the single source of truth: you write and send the daily project emails that tell agents and factories exactly what's needed (timelines, specs, colors, sizing, fabrication, sample requests, testing, changes), you evaluate every sample that comes back, and you chase down whatever is holding a program up — whether that's artwork, packaging, a lab test, a licensor approval, or a factory date. When a program ships on time and right, it's because you caught the wrong Pantone, the missing size, or the expired test before it became a problem.

**Who this is for**

This role is open to someone early in their career or someone with a few years of product development, sourcing, merchandising, or production coordination behind them. A background in textiles, apparel, home goods, or fashion is a real plus (a degree in textile, fashion merchandising, or product development counts). What we can't teach is the mindset: you notice small things — a color that's slightly off, a measurement that doesn't match the spec, a date that moved in one email but not another — and you can't leave them alone. You write clear, complete emails that someone overseas can act on without a follow-up question. You keep your own tracker, you know where every sample is, and you raise a problem the day you see it, not the day it's due.

**Who this isn't for — please read before applying**

Be honest with yourself about these points:

* This is a high-volume, detail-heavy coordination job. Most of your day is email, spreadsheets, spec sheets, and samples. If you're looking for a mainly creative or design role, this isn't it.
* You will manage 20+ programs at once, and in peak season more. Priorities shift daily based on factory responses, retailer requests, and sales meetings. If juggling many open threads at the same time stresses you out, this role will too.
* Accuracy is the job. A wrong color code or size in one email can mean a re-sample, a missed retailer date, or a failed test. "Close enough" is not a standard we can work with.
* Our factories and agents are overseas, so the overnight replies are waiting for you every morning and need clear answers fast.
* This is fully onsite in our New York City office, five days a week.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Daily project communication:** Prepare and maintain a detailed email summary for every assigned program, clearly documenting timelines, required actions, consumer testing, sample requests, product specifications, color details, sizing, fabrications, and factory change requests for agents and factories.
* **Program management:** Manage 20+ active projects daily (volume varies by season), keeping every piece of information accurate, current, and sent on time.
* **Sample evaluation:** Review every incoming sample for design execution, color, sizing, fabrication, construction, quality, and adherence to product specifications.
* **Sample control:** Organize, track, and clearly label all samples through development so they can be found and used the moment they're needed.
* **Sample expediting:** Coordinate and expedite samples for sales meetings, presentations, retailer reviews, and other key milestones.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Keep programs on schedule with internal teams and external partners:
* Art Department — transfer and upload artwork to factories for development, and keep artwork files organized and accessible.
* Packaging Design — confirm packaging is accurate, approved, and aligned with product specs and retailer requirements.
* Director of Product Integrity — make sure products go to the correct retailer-designated testing lab and follow all required testing protocols.
* Production — confirm that factory ship dates and production timelines in your daily communications are accurate and current.
* **Project resources:** Give the Art Department and overseas teams links to current artwork, spec sheets, and development documents — always the latest version.
* **Artwork review:** Check artwork before it goes to factories, flagging color limitations, production restrictions, or anything else that could affect development or final production.
* **Prototypes and color standards:** Coordinate prototypes and color standards with factories so products meet design and quality expectations.
* **Document accuracy:** Review purchase orders, production forms, and related documents for accuracy against approved specifications.
* **Deadline ownership:** Own every program's deadlines and requirements — licensor approvals, retailer requirements, testing, sampling, and development milestones — and make sure each is completed correctly and on time.
* **Problem-solving:** Spot issues early, raise them immediately, and work with the right teams to fix them and keep the program on track.
* **General support:** Assist with sample reviews, meetings, project organization, and other product development tasks as requested.

**Qualifications**

* 0–3+ years in product development, sourcing, merchandising, production, or a related coordination role. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships or coursework are welcome.
* Textile, apparel, home goods, or fashion industry experience strongly preferred; a degree in textiles, fashion merchandising, product development, or a related

While each pod is empowered to execute production independently, Production Services ensures that the entire system runs cohesively– operationally, technically, financially, and strategically. This team is not embedded within pods; it operates horizontally across the organization to enable consistency, scalability, and best-in-class production practices across all disciplines and entities.

Production Services is the backbone of our structure, connecting the creative and executional capabilities of the pods with the systems, tools, and operational discipline that make world-class production possible.

  

**Who you are:** We're looking for a highly organized, adaptable Production Coordinator to support our growing Production team. This role sits at the intersection of in-house agency operations and traditional live-action production—ideal for someone who thrives in logistics, cares about building process, and brings hands-on set experience into an evolving, hybrid production environment. The Production Coordinator will work across multiple brands and projects, supporting several Producers simultaneously. This role requires someone who does not wait for problems to surface but instead identifies potential gaps, proactively provides support, and helps keep productions and internal operations moving forward.

  

**Role Summary**

* Support multiple Producers across a variety of brands, timelines, and deliverables with ad hoc tasks as they arise such as, but not limited to: deck building, vendor outreach, and contract creation.
* Coordinate in person logistics as needed for Production, such as stage holds, edit room holds, lunch orders and customer services

* Maintain organized file structures, documentation, and archival systems for production materials

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 1–3+ years of experience in live-action and/or post production coordinating (agency, production company, or set-based experience all welcome)
* Proficient with Google Suite, Microsoft Suite administrative tools
* Familiarity with production paperwork and crew/vendor processes
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment
* Respond as needed to timely production needs which could be outside standard working hours.

jobs.description:
**The Role**

We’re looking for a motivated Account Manager to join our SMB Account Management team in New York City.

Base salary: $73,000 + $30,000 On-Target Commission (OTC)  
On-Target Earnings (OTE): $103,000

**Working at WGSN**  
**Together, we create tomorrow**

Embark on an exciting career with WGSN, where we offer dynamic opportunities for growth and development in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We are looking for talented Sales and Account Management professionals to join our team and help drive success by delivering WGSN’s trusted insights to our global clients.

As part of our team, you'll work with a diverse group of experts—from trend forecasters and data analysts to designers and content creators—all united by a common goal: to shape the future of design and innovation. You’ll help clients navigate trends across industries including consumer tech, beauty, fashion, interiors and lifestyle, empowering them to create outstanding products.

At WGSN, we believe in the power of consumer and design forecasts to transform businesses. If you have a passion for building strong client relationships, driving commercial growth and helping customers get greater value from the products they use, we want to hear from you.  
Join us at WGSN and take your career in Sales and Account Management to the next level while contributing to the creation of tomorrow's groundbreaking products and services.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you’ll manage a portfolio of small and medium-sized business (SMB) clients with lower contract values, taking ownership of their renewal, retention and growth with WGSN.

This is a high-volume account management role, so being organized, commercially focused and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once will be critical. You’ll oversee a larger portfolio of clients and renewal opportunities, ensuring accounts receive the right level of engagement while keeping momentum across your book of business.

Your primary focus will be retaining existing revenue, identifying risk early and finding opportunities to grow accounts through additional products, teams or longer-term partnerships where there is a clear client need.  
You’ll lead renewal and commercial conversations, deliver product demonstrations and presentations, negotiate agreements and maintain an accurate sales pipeline. You’ll be expected to take ownership of your numbers, prioritize effectively and consistently move opportunities forward.

This role is based in our New York City office with an expectation of three days per week in office. Client meetings may also take place in person, with travel primarily within New York City and the Tri-State area.

**The Team**

Our Account Management team is collaborative, ambitious and commercially focused. You’ll work alongside Account Managers and senior sales leaders, as well as teams across Client Services, Product, Finance and other areas of WGSN.

You’ll be joining an environment where people are encouraged to take ownership, ask questions, share ideas and continuously develop their commercial skills. While everyone owns their individual portfolio and targets, we work as a team to share knowledge, solve challenges and drive results.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Manage an SMB Portfolio: Own a portfolio of small and medium-sized clients across lower contract values, balancing multiple accounts, renewal cycles and commercial opportunities at the same time.
* Drive Retention: Take ownership of annual renewals across your portfolio, engaging clients proactively, identifying potential risks early and creating clear plans to retain revenue.
* Identify Growth Opportunities: Understand how clients are using WGSN and identify relevant opportunities to expand their partnership through additional products, teams or multi-year agreements.
* Manage the Commercial Cycle: Lead opportunities from initial conversation through proposal, negotiation and close, confidently handling pricing, objections and contract discussions.
* Deliver Against Targets: Work toward clear monthly and quarterly revenue targets and activity KPIs, taking ownership of your individual performance and contribution to the wider team.
* Prioritize Effectively: Manage a high volume of accounts efficiently, knowing where deeper engagement is needed and where a more streamlined commercial approach is appropriate.
* Build Client Relationships: Develop relationships with key users and decision-makers across your accounts, understanding their priorities and ensuring WGSN continues to demonstrate value.
* Communicate WGSN’s Value: Deliver engaging product demonstrations, presentations and commercial proposals tailored to clients across industries including Fashion, Beauty, Food & Drink, Interiors and Consumer Tech.
* Maintain an Accurate Pipeline: Keep Salesforce current and accurate, including opportunities, client notes, next steps, close dates and forecasts, providing clear visibility into the health and performance of your portfolio.
* Work Collaboratively: Partner with colleagues across Account Management, Client Services, Product and other teams to support clients while maintaining ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Meet Clients Locally: Build relationships through in-person client engagement where it adds value, primarily across New York City and the Tri-State area.

This list is not exhaustive, and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

**Skills, Experience & Qualifications Required**

* B2B Sales or Account Management Experience: Ideally 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, customer growth or another commercial role.
* Experience Managing Multiple Accounts: Comfortable working across a larger portfolio of customers and managing multiple renewals, opportunities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Track Record of Success: A demonstrable history of achieving or exceeding sales targets. Experience working with subscription-based products or service

jobs.description:
InterPayments is a San Francisco, CA-based, FinTech SaaS company sitting at the exciting intersection of payments and data intelligence. Our Mission is to empower merchants and the software vendors they use to lower payment processing costs. We create innovative data services that Fortune 1000 companies rely upon to lower fees by putting payments in competition on every swipe.

We empower dedicated team-first individuals who are driven to solve problems to foster innovation, perform at their highest potential, and make a meaningful impact - while creating meaningful relationships along the way.

#### **Role and Purpose**

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role at the center of how InterPayments protects and grows its most important merchant relationships. You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise merchants post-go-live and become their primary point of contact for anything strategic: how their program is tracking against savings goals, questions about their contract, and what comes next for their account.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Success and works cross-functionally with Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Finance to ensure our merchants remain compliant, optimized on fee recovery, and confident that someone at InterPayments is accountable for their outcomes.

You are motivated by creating mutual success and comfortable owning a portfolio end to end: the strategic conversations, the day-to-day merchant requests, and the record-keeping that makes your work visible to the rest of the company.

Your time breaks down across three areas: proactive coverage of your portfolio, reactive merchant work, and the administrative discipline that keeps your book measurable.

* **Renewal Conversations:** Lead renewal discussions that combine a program performance review with a clear terms conversation, backed by data on savings delivered and a plan for what comes next.

* **Retention Conversations:** Identify at-risk accounts early, lead the conversation that addresses their concerns directly, and drive the resolution plan through to close.

**Reactive Merchant Work**

* **Expansion Projects:** Screen and scope new expansion opportunities with your merchants, partner with Solutions Architecture on feasibility, and hand off cleanly to Professional Services for implementation.

* **Merchant Projects:** Lead non-expansion technical and program work on live accounts, from discovery through implementation handover.

**Admin and Systems of Record**

* **Post-Meeting Notes, Salesforce and Jira:** Document every merchant meeting promptly and accurately, and keep the systems your teammates and leadership rely on for visibility up to date.

* **Record Hygiene and Reporting Upkeep:** Maintain clean account records and contribute to the trackers and dashboards that give leadership a reliable view of your portfolio's health.

jobs.description:
**Meet PensionBee, we’re here to make retirement simple**
=========================================================

Millions of Americans leave a trail of forgotten 401(k)s behind them every time they change jobs. Small balances get forgotten, fees chip away at savings, and the system makes it a hassle to clean up.

We help people bring their old 401(k)s and IRAs together into one simple, transparent account they can actually understand. For employers, we take small-balance headaches off their hands with automatic rollover solutions that protect former employees' savings and keep plans healthy.

We're a challenger brand in one of the most outdated industries around. We move fast, obsess over our customers, and have zero patience for unnecessary complexity. And we're just getting started in the US.

We move fast, we care deeply about our customers, and we don't do unnecessary complexity. If that sounds like your kind of place, read on.

**About the Role**
------------------

As our Business Development Representative, you'll open doors with financial advisors and TPAs, fill the calendar for our partnerships team, and keep the engine of our US sales process running. It's a great seat for someone who likes the phone, is highly organized, and wants to help build a US team from early on.

**What you'll do**

* Build target lists of advisors and TPAs and book at least 5 new meetings a week through calls, email and LinkedIn.
* Re-engage existing leads to book at least 3 more meetings a week.
* Respond quickly to inbound requests from our website and get meetings on the calendar.
* Prepare briefing notes before meetings, join the calls, and drive the follow-up.
* Keep our CRM (Pipedrive) accurate and hand over new accounts smoothly to Operations.
* Run the weekly sales rhythm, including the team coordination call and the activity summary for US leadership.
* Coordinate our conference calendar, event materials and client activities.

**What you'll bring**

* 1–3 years in an SDR/BDR, inside sales or sales support role, ideally in financial services, retirement or B2B fintech.
* Confidence on the phone and strong written communication.
* An organized, detail-oriented approach and experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, Salesforce or HubSpot).
* Curiosity about retirement and personal finance.

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: You know our product, our buyers, and the competitive landscape. Your first outreach is live.
* 90 days: You're hitting your meeting targets consistently, your handoffs are clean, and you have evidence on which messages and segments work.
* 6 months: You've built a repeatable outbound motion that a second hire could pick up, and you're shaping how we target and position PensionBee in the US.

**Why PensionBee**

* A mission that matters. Help people take control over their retirement savings.
* Early, but proven. A successful business with real traction in the UK, entering its next market.
* Real ownership. A small team, direct access to leadership, and room to grow as the US business does.
* Compensation: $67,000-$72,000 plus bonus
* Benefits: Medical insurance, Vision insurance, Dental insurance, 401(k) Match
* Hybrid working: Three days a week with the team in our Financial District office, two days wherever you work best.

**Sound like your kind of place? We'd love to hear from you.**

jobs.description:
**Mission**
-----------

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn’t be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we’re building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate and lower bills, and make coverage easier to understand—saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the American’s most trusted advocate and partner to manage their healthcare, and healthcare financial decisions.

**About Us**
------------

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we’re a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We’re lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded and have solid runway.

Bill lowering is the hook. People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it — catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring our first in-house Digital Marketing Production Designer to own hands-on creative production across web, email, collateral, and video. You take a brief: usually from marketing and turn it into finished, on-brand assets ready to ship. This is a high-volume execution role: multiple landing pages, email templates, ad cuts, and decks each week, all held to Granted’s brand system and healthcare compliance rules.

One thing to flag up front: ads, landing pages, and emails are the core requirement. Video editing is a strong plus, not a must-have.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Landing page design**

* Design and revise marketing-site and campaign landing pages in Figma (partner pages, patient-stories page, signup screens, and similar).
* Design mobile-first, keep animation minimal, and match each page to the ad that drove the click.
* Work from copy briefs and conversion benchmarks, not aesthetics alone.

### **Email design**

* Design and iterate responsive email templates for lifecycle, promo, and partner (FFGA) sends.
* Keep templates consistent with the design system: icons, logo lockups, buttons, and spacing.

### **Collateral design**

* Build BD and partner decks, including reusable base templates that partner-specific versions fork from.
* Produce sales enablement materials and co-branded partner assets (e.g., FFGA x Granted), plus a self-serve asset library reps and HR teams can pull from.
* Turn around one-off brand and marketing design requests as they come in.

### **Social-first video editing**

* Cut UGC and talking-head ads into multiple lengths (e.g., 15s and 30s) and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) for Meta and YouTube.
* Burn in captions, add B-roll and text reveals, and keep the edit moving so it holds retention through the hook.
* Version and riff winning ads: new hooks, on-screen insurer callouts, swapped presenters (including AI-generated), and platform re-cuts from existing masters.
* Build light motion graphics and AI-assisted animation, such as product and explainer sequences (e.g., a bill-scan animation).

**You'll Bring**
----------------

### **Must-haves:**

* 3+ years in production or creative design, with a portfolio spanning web, email, and static work.
* Proficiency in Figma for landing pages and web layouts.
* Responsive email design in an ESP (Klaviyo, Customer.io, or similar).
* Comfort designing to an existing brand system and holding output consistent across formats.
* Fast, reliable turnaround on high volume; you can read a written brief and run with it.

### **Nice-to-haves:**

* Social-first video editing in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent — captioning, resizing, and fast multi-cut delivery.
* Motion graphics or AI-assisted animation experience.

### **Toolkit:**

Figma, Adobe Premiere and After Effects (or CapCut), an ESP for email (Klaviyo or Customer.io), Canva, Linear for briefs and tickets, Slack, and Notion.

**You'll Thrive Here If**
-------------------------

* You get energy from taking a rough brief and shipping the finished thing — the ad cut, the landing page, the email — not just art-directing it
* You move fast without dropping the details: multiple versions a week, every one on-brand and within the compliance rules
* You like variety and don’t need to own one polished flagship — you’d rather turn around video, web, email, and decks and see what actually performs
* You care about the same problem Granted is solving — helping people who are stressed and overwhelmed feel like someone’s actually on their side

Compensation Range: $100K - $160K

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Community Manager to own Pure's day-to-day social media presence and build an engaged community around the brand. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn an idea into a post, keep a content calendar moving, and make our channels feel active and worth following. You'll create and publish content, respond to our audience, and use performance data and community feedback to improve what we put out. Social media management is the primary focus, with community engagement woven into the daily work.

This role is based full-time in our New York City office.

**You will:**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing across channels such as Instagram, TikTok, and X, adapting the format, copy, and timing to each platform
* Create and edit social content, including short-form videos, captions, stories, memes, and simple graphics; work with designers and video editors when additional production support is needed
* Manage comments, mentions, and direct messages with a consistent brand voice; answer common questions, encourage conversation, and route account or payment issues to the appropriate support team
* Spot relevant trends, player stories, and conversations in poker, gaming, and internet culture, and turn them into timely content that fits Pure's audience and brand
* Coordinate with marketing, product, and creator partnerships on launches, announcements, events, and creator content; manage asset collection, approvals, and publishing deadlines
* Track reach, engagement, shares, saves, video watch time, audience growth, and referral traffic; report on what is working and test new formats, hooks, and posting times
* Monitor community sentiment and recurring feedback, share useful insights with the team, and flag sensitive issues promptly; follow internal moderation and content approval guidelines

**Qualifications:**

* Experience managing social media accounts for a brand, startup, creator, or community, with examples of content you created and results you helped drive
* Strong writing and editing skills, a feel for internet culture, and the ability to adapt a brand's voice across posts, comments, and direct messages
* Comfortable shooting and editing short-form video and making simple social assets with tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite
* Organized and responsive, with the judgment to manage a publishing calendar, prioritize community replies, and use platform analytics to improve content
* Familiarity with poker, gaming, sports, or consumer apps is a plus; comfortable learning the product and explaining it clearly to new and existing users
* Must be able to work on-site in our New York City office

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Free Equinox membership for the in-person team
* Dinner provided in the office every night
* Up to $60/day for other meals when in the office (in-person team)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of premiums covered by the company, starting on your first day
* Weekly dry cleaning and laundry service for the in-person team
* Company computer

Pure is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Compensation Range: $90K - $150K

As a Sales Representative, you’ll represent AT&T in a retail environment, speak with customers about smartphones and wireless services, answer questions, and help customers choose products and plans. You’ll receive hands-on training and support while building valuable sales, communication, and customer service skills.

**No previous wireless sales experience is required.** Experience in retail, hospitality, customer service, restaurants, or other people-focused roles is a plus.

**What You’ll Do as a Sales Representative**

* Welcome customers and create a positive, professional experience.
* Represent AT&T by introducing customers to smartphones, wireless services, promotions, and available upgrades.
* Ask questions to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate AT&T products and services.
* Demonstrate smartphones, wireless features, and available promotions in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
* Help customers with upgrades, new lines, transfers, and other account needs.
* Explain current offers, device options, and wireless plans to help customers make informed decisions.
* Build strong customer relationships while working toward individual and team sales goals.
* Keep customer information and sales records accurate.
* Work with your team to create a welcoming and productive retail environment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Comfortable speaking with customers face-to-face.
* Motivated, dependable, and team-oriented.
* Interest in technology, smartphones, or wireless services.
* Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.
* Retail, sales, hospitality, restaurant, or customer service experience is a plus, but **not required**.
* **Entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply.**

**Why Join StratosMark, Inc.?**

* Entry-level Sales Representative opportunity.
* Hands-on training and ongoing support.
* Learn valuable sales and customer service skills.
* Opportunities to **grow within the company and take on greater responsibilities**.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Work in a fast-paced, customer-focused retail environment.

Benefits:

* Employee discount

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative/Inspection Agent
jobs.description:
Drivo Rent A Car is a leading player in the car rental industry. We are committed to delivering top-notch service to our customers while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment for our employees. At our city locations, each agent handles the full rental journey, from preparing the rental agreement at the counter to inspecting the vehicle at check-out and return. Each day will be challenging and exciting for the right person.

**Why Choose Drivo Rent A Car?**

* Exciting opportunities: competitive compensation and opportunities for advancement within the company. High performance will lead to promotion and pay raises.
* Positive work environment: a supportive and collaborative culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Training and development: excellent training sessions and ongoing development programs to help you excel in both customer service and vehicle inspection.

**The ideal candidate possesses the following attributes:**

* Exceptional interpersonal, customer service and relationship-building skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task
* Ability to manage stressful or unusual situations while maintaining good customer service
* Ability to learn about the customer's rental needs and upgrade them to a more premium vehicle and additional services that will enhance their experience
* Familiarity with video inspection processes and basic photography skills for capturing pre-existing conditions
* Ability to manage traffic flow efficiently

**What you will do:**

Rental and sales

* Prepare the rental agreement while advising on and up-selling vehicles and optional extras according to the customer's needs and wants
* Provide excellent customer service in all customer contact situations
* Meet all sales and service standards
* Assist customers with inquiries about car features and conditions
* Inform customers of return policies (e.g., No Smoking, No Pet Hair, Gas)

Vehicle check-out

* Ensure high-quality video check-out processes
* Record pre-existing conditions by capturing additional photos

Vehicle return and inspection

* Greet customers dropping off rental cars with a warm smile
* Secure vehicle keys, confirm documentation and perform necessary checks
* Perform video inspections for damage and remind customers to check for personal belongings
* Identify and record lost items found in vehicles with detailed information
* Thoroughly review cars for damage upon return, and open and file claims promptly
* Park units requiring service in designated areas and inform the Service Supervisor

Branch support

* Control traffic flow as a guide for incoming and outgoing rental cars
* Assist the branch with the return and turnaround of vehicles
* Complete administrative tasks, including daily lists to assist the office
* Perform other job duties as assigned to meet business needs

**About you:**

* High school diploma or GED
* Minimum 1 year of customer service or sales experience
* Must be at least 18 and have a valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Experience meeting sales quotas or working in highly commissioned positions preferred
* Ability to follow defined service and sales processes
* Must be willing to wear company uniforms
* Ability to communicate in English; speaking other languages, including Spanish, is a plus

**Position available at BRK and BRKJS city locations**  
**Salary: From $18.00 per hour - $20.00 per hour + Comissions**  
**Expected hours: 40 per week**

jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner and Clinical Research Coordinator/Rater
jobs.description:
Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner and clinical research rater (Senior Level) — Psychiatry & Neurology

About Us

Manhattan Behavioral Medicine is an independent clinical research site conducting industry-sponsored trials in psychiatry and neurology.

We are seeking a Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner to bring both advanced clinical expertise and senior-level research operations experience to our psychiatry and neurology trials. In this hybrid role, you will provide protocol-directed clinical assessment and medical oversight in partnership with our Principal Investigator, while also leading study coordination activities and mentoring our research staff. This position is ideal for an NP who has worked as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator and understands what it takes to run industry-sponsored drug trials well from both the clinical and operational sides.

Key Responsibilities

**Clinical Responsibilities**

* Perform protocol-required clinical assessments, including medical and psychiatric histories, physical and neurological exams, and review of concomitant medications, within NP scope of practice and under PI delegation.
* Assess participant eligibility and ongoing suitability for study participation, in collaboration with the Principal Investigator.
* Evaluate, document, and follow up on adverse events and serious adverse events, including causality and severity assessment as delegated; ensure timely reporting to sponsors and the IRB.
* Conduct participant safety monitoring, including suicidality assessment (e.g., C-SSRS), vital signs, ECGs, and review of laboratory results.
* Administer or oversee standardized psychiatric and neurological rating scales and cognitive assessments per protocol.
* Serve as sub-investigator on select studies where permitted by state law, institutional policy, and sponsor requirements.
* Provide clinical guidance to the research team on medical questions and participant concerns, and escalate urgent issues to the PI as appropriate.

**Study Leadership & Coordination**

* Serve as lead clinical and operational point of contact on assigned industry-sponsored drug trials, from site initiation through closeout.
* Partner with sponsors, CRAs, and monitors; prepare for and support site initiation visits, monitoring visits, and audits.
* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and sponsor requirements across regulatory documentation, source documentation, and informed consent processes.
* Oversee investigational product accountability, EDC data entry, and query resolution in collaboration with coordination staff.
* Support IRB submissions, protocol amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Mentor and train clinical research coordinators and other research staff on protocol requirements, clinical procedures, and best practices.
* Contribute to site feasibility assessments, recruitment and retention planning, and process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Active, unrestricted license as a Nurse Practitioner (APRN) in NY and NJ, with national board certification (e.g., PMHNP-BC, FNP-BC, AGNP-BC, or equivalent).
* Master's degree (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) from an accredited program.
* Minimum of [2–3] years of clinical research experience, including prior experience as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator on industry-sponsored drug trials.
* Experience in psychiatry and/or neurology clinical trials.
* Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and human subjects protection requirements.
* Current GCP and human subjects research training; current BLS/CPR certification.
* Proficiency with EDC systems and clinical trial management systems.
* Excellent clinical judgment, organizational skills, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent studies.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience serving as a sub-investigator on FDA-regulated trials.
* Experience with CNS rating scale training and certification processes.
* Certification such as CCRC (SOCRA) or CCRP (ACRP).
* DEA registration and prescriptive authority, as applicable to the role.
* Experience mentoring or supervising research staff.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or a minimum of 5 years of construction administration experience.

Experience supporting construction projects through project coordination, contract administration, or project controls activities.

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Outlook.

Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to effectively communicate with clients, contractors, stakeholders, project teams, and leadership.

Ability to follow written, verbal, and visual instructions and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Familiarity with project management software such as PMWeb, Expedition, e-Builder, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with construction administration, contract documentation, and project delivery processes.

  
  

**Ideally, you'll also have:**

OSHA 10 certification.

Experience supporting aviation, transportation, infrastructure, or public-sector construction projects.

Familiarity with critical path method (CPM) scheduling concepts and schedule analysis.

Familiarity with construction cost estimating, project controls, and contract administration practices.

Experience preparing project reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentations.

Experience coordinating among diverse stakeholder groups in active construction environments.

Knowledge of document control and project information management best practices.

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University:

Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community.

Description:

The Program Coordinator (ETS) primary duties are organizing, coordinating, and planning operational facets of a program and its related activities which include, but are not limited to the following: establishing long-term operational objectives, researching factors that may impact the success of the program, and working with individuals or groups to research and document program requirements in order to provide appropriate input into the development of strategic plans.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develops work plans to accomplish program goals and objectives and monitors progress toward their achievement.
* Conducts research and gathers information to develop various publications.
* Develops promotional materials which may include content for reports, briefings, newsletters, grants or other written information related to the program.
* Assists in developing and coordinating program-related conferences, conventions, or meetings.
* Monitors expenditures and may participate in the budget planning process and prepare financial reports.
* May assist in identifying funding resources and developing fund-raising strategies and initiatives.
* Prepares operational and statistical reports.
* Conducts training, represents the program at meetings and conferences, and networks with affiliated groups.
* May supervise assigned project staff, interns and/or volunteers.
* Performs related responsibilities as required.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Assist with student registration process during enrollment blocks and drop/add periods.
* Track and assist with drafting goal setting plans for students that require additional support.

**Core Competencies**  
These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment.

  

1. **Patient-Centered Care** – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high-quality care that prioritizes the well-being and satisfaction of patients and their families.

6. **Quality & Safety** – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes.
  
7. **Adaptability & Resilience** – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure.
  
8. **Continuous Improvement** – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
  
9. **Leadership & Professionalism** – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.
  
10. **Employee Experience Focus** – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care.

**Grady Total Rewards**  
At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our **Total Rewards** package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

* Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

jobs.title: Part-Time Healthcare Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
Part-Time Healthcare Outreach Coordinator

$15.00 per hour + Commission Opportunities | Approximately 20 Hours per Week | Part-Time

**Industry**: Healthcare / Physician Services

**Position Overview**

A growing physician practice is seeking a professional, outgoing, and motivated Part-Time Healthcare Outreach Coordinator to support facility outreach and business development.

The primary focus of this position is to connect with healthcare facilities, build professional relationships, and identify their current and anticipated physician staffing needs. The Outreach Coordinator will gather information regarding the physician specialties and services facilities are seeking and communicate those opportunities back to practice leadership for follow-up and recruitment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is comfortable meeting new people, building professional relationships, and representing a growing healthcare organization in the community.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Conduct outreach to healthcare facilities and organizations within assigned markets.

● Visit facilities in person to introduce the practice and establish professional relationships.

● Connect with facility leadership, administrators, clinical leaders, and other appropriate decision-makers.

● Identify and assess each facility’s current and anticipated physician staffing needs.

● Determine which physician specialties or services facilities are actively seeking.

● Gather relevant information regarding potential physician coverage and partnership opportunities.

● Communicate identified staffing needs and opportunities to practice leadership for follow-up.

● Identify potential partnership and contract opportunities for the practice.

● Schedule follow-up meetings or presentations with practice leadership when appropriate.

● Maintain an organized pipeline of facility contacts, opportunities, and follow-up activity.

● Track outreach efforts, facility needs, contacts, meetings, leads, and potential contracts.

● Maintain consistent communication and follow-up with prospective facility partners.

● Represent the practice professionally and maintain confidentiality at all times.

**Qualifications**

● High school diploma or equivalent.

● Strong verbal and written communication skills.

● Professional, confident, and comfortable communicating with healthcare facility leadership.

● Comfortable making outbound calls and conducting in-person facility visits.

● Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

● Reliable transportation for local outreach and facility visits.

● Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

● Basic computer and email proficiency and the ability to learn new systems.

● Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently.

● Willingness to learn about physician services, healthcare facility operations, and business development.

**Experience in healthcare, physician services, senior living, business development, sales, marketing, community outreach, or customer service is preferred but not required.**

**Compensation & Commission**

**Base Pay**: $15.00 per hour

**Schedule**: Approximately 20 hours per week

In addition to hourly compensation, the Outreach Coordinator will have the opportunity to earn commission for qualifying new business contracts generated through their direct outreach and business-development efforts.

Commission eligibility, payment timing, and qualifying requirements will be outlined in the practice’s written commission plan.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for someone who is personable, professional, persistent, organized, and comfortable taking initiative. The ideal candidate enjoys meeting people, developing professional relationships, asking the right questions, and identifying opportunities.

You should be comfortable walking into healthcare facilities, speaking with leadership, learning about their physician staffing needs, and maintaining relationships through consistent follow-up.

This position offers hands-on exposure to physician practice development, healthcare partnerships, facility outreach, and healthcare business development, with opportunities for additional earnings based on results.

**To Apply**: Submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining why you are interested in healthcare outreach and why you would be a strong fit for the position.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Pay: $15.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30318

**Pay:**  Starting at $15/hour

Phone & Customer Service

* Answer basic customer questions or direct customers to the appropriate person
* Provide a welcoming and professional experience for every caller
* Monitor missed calls and ensure messages are properly documented
* Communicate important customer information to the appropriate team members

Social Media & Online Communications

* Monitor incoming messages and inquiries through Facebook, Instagram, and other social media platforms
* Respond to customer and prospect messages promptly and professionally
* Identify potential leads and make sure they are properly documented

Data Entry & Lead Management

* Enter new prospects and customer information into the company's database/CRM

* Keep contact information accurate and up to date
* Record notes and follow-up information from customer interactions

Qualifications

* Previous customer service, receptionist, administrative, or office experience preferred
* Excellent telephone and communication skills
* Friendly and professional personality
* Strong attention to detail
* Good computer skills
* Comfortable learning new software and systems
* Ability to type accurately and efficiently
* Strong organizational skills
* Ability to multitask and prioritize incoming calls and messages
* Reliable and punctual
* Ability to work independently while also being a team player
* Professional written communication skills

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* CRM or customer-management software
* Facebook and Instagram
* Meta Business Suite
* Google Workspace
* Microsoft Office
* Data entry
* Lead management
* Customer service or call-center experience

What We're Looking For

The right person for this position is someone who is **organized, dependable, friendly, and detail-oriented**.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of their responsibilities, stay organized throughout the day, and help make sure that no customer or potential lead gets overlooked.

Compensation

**Starting at $15 per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications.

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your customer service, phone, administrative, or data-entry experience.

**About the Role**
------------------

At LoadUp, our partners count on us to take care of their customers the same way we take care of our own. As an Account Manager, Partnerships, you'll own the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of partner accounts, including e-commerce brands, retailers, moving and logistics companies, and property managers. You'll make sure they're onboarded smoothly, billed accurately, and supported quickly when issues come up. This is an execution-focused, high-communication role on our Business Development team. You'll report to the Director of Strategic Partnerships and work closely with Accounting, Operations, and Partner Support to keep accounts running smoothly and build partner relationships that support retention and growth. This is a full-time role.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set up new partner accounts end-to-end, including credit applications, required compliance documentation, and partner portal credentials
* Configure partner-specific account settings such as branding, pricing and item mappings, and integration or test environments as needed
* Own onboarding, quoting, service issues, and billing follow-up for an assigned portfolio of partner accounts
* Provide accurate, timely quotes for service requests, including location- or scope-based pricing adjustments, and re-quote when a job's scope changes after the fact
* Coordinate with delivery and installation partners on scheduling, day-of issues, and changes to a job's scope
* Serve as the first point of contact for partner-reported service issues and drive them to resolution with Operations and Partner Support
* Respond promptly to partner questions about their account, orders, and reporting, escalating platform or data limitations when needed
* Troubleshoot account access and login issues for new and existing users
* Monitor outstanding invoices for assigned accounts and follow up on overdue balances on a predictable, proactive cadence
* Resolve invoice discrepancies with the Accounting team and provide supporting documentation, such as proof of service and receipts, on request
* Uphold LoadUp's brand values in every partner interaction
* Travel occasionally (up to 25% of the time) for partner visits, industry conferences, and trade shows

### **What You'll Bring**

* 2+ years of experience in account management, partner or vendor support, customer success, or a similar client-facing operations role
* Excellent written communication skills with a professional, service-oriented tone, and a commitment to consistent, timely responses to partner emails and account issues
* Strong organization, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and open items at once without dropping details
* A calm, patient, solutions-first approach to resolving concerns from frustrated partners or customers
* Basic familiarity with invoicing and accounts receivable workflows
* A team-first attitude and the ability to collaborate across Accounting, Operations, and Partner Support
* Experience with a CRM (ideally HubSpot) and support or ticketing tools preferred
* Experience in logistics, delivery, e-commerce, or a related industry preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, preferred

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Health & wellness coverage
* Generous paid time off
* 401(k) with 5% company match
* Monthly lifestyle stipends, employee recognition programs, and referral bonuses

LoadUp is a tech-powered, on-demand junk removal and home services platform, connecting individuals and businesses nationwide with a vetted network of local providers for removal, disposal, assembly, and hourly labor. Founded in 2014, LoadUp set out to replace an industry known for hidden fees and vague pricing with real-time, upfront pricing and dependable local pros — no guessing, no surprises, just honest service done right. Today, LoadUp is one of the largest on-demand junk removal and home services platforms in the country. We've been named to Inc.'s 5000 list of Fastest-Growing Companies and have been a certified Great Place to Work since 2019. As we continue growing, we're looking for talented, driven people who want to help reimagine what this industry can be.

Onsite | Avalon, Alpharetta, GA (Metro Atlanta / Greater Atlanta / North Atlanta)

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Innovation
jobs.description:
**ABOUT OLIPOP**

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

**Role Overview**

The Innovation Project Manager is the operational backbone of the Innovation team, translating ideas and priorities into clear plans, coordinated workstreams, and successful execution.

This role owns project timelines, team tools, cross-functional communication, and operational processes across the innovation pipeline, working independently to keep complex, fast-moving work on track. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and energized by bringing structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving work.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project & Pipeline Management

* Own project plans, timelines, milestones, and action logs for innovation initiatives from concept through launch.

* Lead cross-functional execution across Innovation, Commercial, Science & Medical Affairs, R&D, Brand, Insights, Commercialization, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Sales aligning partners on priorities, owners, and next steps.

* Anticipate risks and dependencies before they affect timing, develop mitigation plans, and escalate only when leadership decisions are needed.

* Own the innovation pipeline tools and launch calendar as the single source of truth for stakeholders.

Team Operations

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Business Development
jobs.description:
**Outside Sales Representative – Business Development**

**Disaster Restoration (B2B) | Norcross, GA | Territory: Greater Atlanta**

**$60,000–$80,000 Base Salary • Uncapped Commission • $100K+ Income Potential • Vehicle Allowance**

**You Already Know Half the People on Your Prospect List**

If you've spent a few years calling on property managers, plumbers, contractors, or insurance offices anywhere around Atlanta, you've built something valuable — and you probably haven't been paid much for it.

Nobody writes you a check because a facility manager in Marietta trusts your judgment, or because you can get a plumbing company owner on the phone on a Tuesday afternoon. Those relationships just sit there, quietly worth something.

This job pays you for exactly that.

Metro Atlanta is more than six million people, an enormous multifamily footprint, and tens of thousands of commercial buildings. Water damage, mold, and property emergencies happen across all of it, every single week. Somebody is going to be the person those property professionals call first when it does.

**We're hiring the person who wants that to be them.**

**Why the Income Compounds Instead of Resetting**

Most sales jobs start over at zero every January. This one doesn't, because of who you're selling to.

A plumber running service calls across the north metro will run into water losses over and over. A property manager may be responsible for hundreds of units. An insurance agent talks with property owners all day long. A facility manager may oversee an entire portfolio of buildings.

Earn the trust of any one of those people and you haven't made a sale — you've opened a source of work that keeps producing long after the meeting that started it.

So you're not chasing one-off homeowners. You're building a network of repeat referral partners and commercial accounts:

* Insurance agents and adjusters
* Plumbers, HVAC companies, and contractors
* Property managers and multifamily professionals
* Facility managers and commercial property professionals

Year one, you're building. Year three, you're still building — on top of everything that's already producing.

**To Be Clear: You Will Have to Go Get It**

Relationship selling and passive networking are not the same thing. Nobody is going to hand you a list of warm accounts and ask you to maintain it.

You'll be opening doors that are currently closed — introducing yourself to businesses that have never heard of us, asking for the meeting, and following up longer than most salespeople are willing to.

**You'll have structure, systems, and leadership behind you. You'll still be the one who has to execute.**

**What an Actual Tuesday Looks Like**

* Out in the territory meeting property managers, plumbers, and adjusters face-to-face
* Walking into businesses that don't know us yet and introducing the company
* Running consultative conversations about how properties get protected — not product pitches
* Attending association meetings, industry events, and networking functions where our customers already gather
* Following up on the twelve conversations you started last week
* Keeping your pipeline and activity current in CRM
* Coordinating with operations when a relationship turns into an active job, so the work reflects well on you

**Six to Twelve Months In, Here's What Winning Looks Like**

* A real referral network that produces opportunities without you chasing every one
* Consistent qualified meetings on your calendar every week
* Visible presence in the Atlanta property and contractor community
* A healthy, growing pipeline you can actually forecast from
* Repeat business from partners who called you the first time and kept calling
* **Income trending toward $100K+**

Staying busy is not the measure. Activity that turns into relationships that turn into revenue is.

**Who You'd Be Representing**

Leak Pros of Georgia & Mold-B-Gone is a growing restoration company in Norcross that was built around a real sales organization — not one bolted on as an afterthought.

That matters more than it sounds. It means the systems, the leadership, and the marketing are set up to help a salesperson produce consistently instead of improvising alone. When you spend six months earning a property manager's trust, there's an operation behind you capable of protecting it.

**If This Sounds Like You**

Apply. Tell us about a relationship you built that turned into real business, and what it took to get there.

Atlanta's territory is open. We'd rather hand it to someone who's been waiting for a job like this than keep looking for someone perfect.

 **Requirements**

**Who Fits This Role**

You'll do well here if you have:

* **2+ years of B2B outside sales experience**
* Comfort building a territory from zero rather than inheriting one
* Genuine networking and relationship-building ability — people remember you
* Real self-discipline and follow-through, because nobody is watching your calendar for you
* Coachability, without needing to be managed day to day

Existing relationships in property management, multifamily, construction, or insurance are a significant advantage. They are not a requirement — but if you have them, this is where they finally start paying you back.

If you're looking for inbound leads, a short transactional cycle, or a territory someone else already warmed up, this won't be a fit.

 **Benefits**

**What It Pays**

* **$60,000–$80,000 base salary**
* **Uncapped commission**
* **$100K+ income potential**
* Vehicle allowance, plus gas card / company credit card
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans available
* HSA / FSA available
* 401(k) with up to 4% company match
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Company laptop and phone, with technology support
* Career growth opportunity in a growing market

The base is real money on its own. The commission is where this role separates itself over time.

* Partner closely with Marketing and your assigned AE(s) to align on target accounts, messaging, and follow-up on campaigns/events

* Track and report on your own conversion metrics (meetings booked, meetings held, meeting-to-opportunity rate) and adjust approach based on what's converting

**Required Skills/Experience**

o Prior outbound B2B, Enterprise Saas SDR/BDR quota-carrying experience required. Relevant cybersecurity product experience is also required.

o Knowledge of enterprise business organizational structures and buying influencers, with a proven ability to run structured, multi-touch outbound campaigns.

Comfortable with data: you know your own conversion metrics and use them to improve, not just to report. Solid history of performance.

o Career: passion for sales and technology - desire to ‘grow’ your sales career with a top-notch cybersecurity vendor and genuine curiosity in the product space.

o Coachability: able to listen and take training/feedback with a positive approach.

o Adaptability: open and eager to understand bleeding edge information, security concepts and approaches in a rapidly-changing environment.

o Communication style: clear, concise and effective communicator.

o Education Level: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience (3yrs relevant professional experience).

o Experienced with AI-assisted prospecting and sales engagement tools (e.g., Gong, Nooks, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude/ChatGPT) to work smarter, not just harder. We expect fluency with modern GTM tooling, not just activity volume

o Plus: structured sales training and/or Salesforce.com experience

o This position is based in the Eastern US/Eastern or Central Time Zones highly preferred.

o This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. The successful candidate must not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship to work in the US.

* Respond quickly to incoming internet leads

* Contact customers through phone, text, and email
* Schedule appointments for the dealership sales department
* Follow up with customers who have previously inquired about vehicles
* Maintain consistent follow-up using **VinSolutions CRM**
* Accurately document all customer interactions
* Confirm upcoming appointments
* Follow up with missed appointments
* Work closely with dealership sales managers and sales consultants
* Maintain daily call, appointment, and activity goals
* Provide professional and courteous customer service

Required Experience

* Previous Automotive BDC, Internet Sales, or dealership sales experience

* **Dealertrack DMS experience helpful**
* Strong telephone and communication skills
* Experience handling internet leads

* Ability to manage multiple customers and leads simultaneously
* Goal-oriented and motivated by performance
* Reliable and professional

Management candidates should also have previous experience supervising or managing a dealership BDC, internet sales department, or similar automotive sales operation.

We are looking for individuals who understand that successful automotive BDC operations require **speed, persistence, organization, and consistent follow-up**.

The ideal candidate understands how to turn an internet inquiry or phone call into an appointment and ultimately into a showroom opportunity.

**Automotive experience is required. This is not an entry-level BDC position.**

If you’re a self-starter with a competitive mindset and a drive to dominate your market, this is the role for you!

* **Solution-Based Sales Expertise:** Proficient in asking insightful questions and identifying pain points to influence and engage decision-makers, offering customized solutions at all levels.
* **Market Insight:** Ability to analyze market trends and client needs to drive tailored solutions.

* **Team Player:** Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and adapt in dynamic environments.

Work hard, grow fast. At MultiPro Property Solutions, we recognize talent, reward ambition, and promote from within. If you’re looking for a place where effort leads to opportunity, innovation is encouraged, and leadership is earned, you’ve found it.

**Robust Training Program:**

* 4-week structured onboarding program to set you up for success
* Hands-on mentorship and ongoing support

* **Flexible Time Off:** No preset accruals—manage your time and work-life balance your way, plus 10 company-paid holidays.
* **Financial Security:** 401k with company match, life and disability insurance, AD&D, and business travel coverage
* **Professional Development:** Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 per year and access to our online education center
* **Additional Perks:** Referral bonuses, pet insurance, associate assistance programs, discount programs, rewards, recognition, and free access to Torch Fitness virtual programs

The final compensation offered will be determined based on various factors, including the candidate's location, level of experience, and skill set. As such, it may fall outside the range listed above. OTE varies based on performance.

jobs.description:
**About us**

Crabapple Martial Arts Academy is a family-focused martial arts school in Milton, GA (the Crabapple / Alpharetta area). We teach children and families focus, confidence, discipline, and respect — skills that show up in the classroom, at home, and for life. We're the flagship school of a growing martial-arts company, so there's real room to grow with us.

**The opportunity**

We're hiring a Sales and Enrollment Representative to be the person who brings new families through our doors. You'll start by getting our name into the community and booking families for their first lesson. As you prove yourself, you'll grow into closing new enrollments and selling our long-term programs — with your pay growing at every step. This is for someone who loves people, loves to win, and wants their income to reflect their results.

* Build interest in the community through school events, local partnerships, and referral events

**How you'll grow — and earn more**

This role is built in stages. You start by filling our pipeline and booking appointments. Once you do that consistently, we add enrollment and commission on every family you sign. Once you've proven that, we add our long-term program sales — the highest-earning part of the job. Each stage adds responsibility and pay.

* 2+ years in a goal-driven, customer-facing role (sales, membership or enrollment sales, business development, recruiting, real estate, hospitality, or similar)

* Experience in martial arts, fitness, youth programs, or another membership business
* Familiarity with a CRM or lead-tracking tool
* Roots in the Milton / Alpharetta community
