* $48,000 base salary, steady from day one
* Monthly performance bonus while you build the pipeline
* Uncapped commission as you take on enrollment and long-term sales
* Milestone bonuses tied to the academy's growth
* Typical first-year earnings around $60,000; top performers $90,000–$125,000+

Pay: From $48,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO & CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  
About DO & CO
  
  
We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges & Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO & CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready-to-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready-to-eat and high-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation-related deficiencies.
* Review pest-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non-Halal cross-contact.
* Lead sanitation-related investigations and root-cause analyses.
* Develop risk-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.

The Del Rios lab, housed within the section of Emergency Medicine, centers on identifying and mitigating place-based barriers to preventing and surviving catastrophic medical emergencies. We partner with multidisciplinary, multi-institutional research teams to combine rigorous quantitative methods, community engagement, and implementation-focused approaches to address urgent public health challenges, including out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, respiratory virus communication, and the mental health effects of structural and policy environments on minoritized youth. Our work emphasizes the use of mixed methods including machine learning, statistical modeling, epidemiology, and health services research, while fostering trusted community partnerships to develop practical, scalable strategies that improve preparedness, strengthen public health communication, and advance equitable health outcomes.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

Material Bank is seeking a strategic **Enterprise Account Manager** to lead relationships with a portfolio of our largest Brand Partners. You will serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for your Brand Partners, developing a deep understanding of their businesses, goals, and priorities and helping them maximize the value and impact of their partnership with Material Bank.

You will develop long term account strategies, lead quarterly business reviews, and translate platform performance and data into meaningful insights and recommendations. You will also guide Brand Partners through renewals and identify opportunities to expand the partnership when they align with their objectives and can deliver additional value.

This is a highly strategic and hands on role for someone who enjoys building meaningful relationships while using data, industry knowledge, and business judgment to help Brand Partners succeed. The right candidate will be equally comfortable engaging with senior executives, digging into performance data, navigating complex challenges, and bringing together teams across Material Bank to deliver measurable outcomes for our Brand Partners.

**What You'll Do:**

* Brand Partner Success: Take ownership of the overall success of your Brand Partners, developing a deep understanding of their businesses, priorities, and goals and ensuring their partnership with Material Bank continues to deliver meaningful value.
* Account Strategy: Develop a thoughtful, data informed strategy for each Brand Partner, identifying priorities, opportunities, and actions that can strengthen performance and support their long term objectives.
* Growth & Expansion: Identify opportunities to deepen and expand partnerships where Material Bank can provide additional value, connecting recommendations directly to each Brand Partner's goals and business needs.
* Renewals & Retention: Lead the renewal process from planning through completion, proactively demonstrating value, addressing concerns, and building alignment around the continued partnership.
* Executive Relationships: Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across Brand Partner organizations, including senior leadership, creating strong alignment around goals, performance, and opportunities for continued growth.
* Business Reviews: Lead strategic business reviews with Brand Partner leadership, bringing together performance data, insights, industry context, and recommendations that help inform decisions and identify opportunities.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic or enterprise account management within design, building product or related A&D industries, with direct renewal and expansion accountability
* Strong executive presence and communication skills; able to connect with senior audiences
* Proven ability to build relationships as a strategic partner ensuring lasting account relationships
* Experience carrying a multi-million enterprise account level book of business
* Genuine fluency with data, able to work with data sets to identify trends and opportunities as well as formulate insights helpful to account success
* High level of judgement when it comes to determining what matters and what doesn't, and standing behind the trade-off
* Unwavering accountability, adaptability, and drive to deliver results and care for your accounts
* Travel required with the intention of face-to-face account meetings and professional networking

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**

At Material Bank, we're building the future of design through a platform that connects leading brands and professionals with speed, intelligence, and sustainability at the core.

***What you'll get from us:***

* ***Our people****: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.*
* ***Relaxation and Celebrations****: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect).*
* ***Health Benefits******:*** *We* *contribute* *to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term* *disability plans* *and have a strong employee assistance program.*
* ***Plan for your Retirement******:*** *401(k)* *eligible* *after your first 90 day's employed!*
* ***Giving Back****: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities.*
* ***Growth****: We'll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters!*
* ***Flexible Work Schedules****: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a* ***hybrid working*** *model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.*

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**

Reports To: **Vice President of Business Development**

Location: **Chicago, IL**

Environment: **Onsite with hybrid flexibility after training (1 day/week remote)**

Status: **Exempt, Salaried**

**Who We Are:**

Recognized by Gartner in their Modern 4PL Market Guide, Redwood Logistics is at the forefront of industry innovation. Our cutting-edge supply chain technology pairs with the expertise of our brilliant minds to empower logistics execution across North America and Mexico.

Leveraging a comprehensive range of services, data-centric network solutions, and a seamlessly integrated platform, we have established our prominence as a key player in the mid-market segment within the freight tech industry.

Whether you’re just starting your career or are an established professional looking for your next opportunity, Redwood inspires innovation across teams to provide transformative solutions for our customers.

**Purpose of Your Work:**

As an **Account Manager** working within **Redwood Multimodal** (one of our entities),you will be responsible for supporting the successful execution of customer freight within a third-party brokerage environment. You will serve as a key point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal teams, ensuring loads are accurately quoted, scheduled, covered, tracked, and resolved through delivery.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced transportation environment.

**How You Make a Difference Everyday:**

* Support day-to-day account management and operational execution for assigned customers.
* Provide responsive service to customers, carriers, and internal partners.
* Coordinate quoting activity, load coverage, appointments, issue resolution, and reporting.
* Identify potential service issues early and drive them through resolution.
* Maintain accurate information across transportation systems and customer platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

Quoting and Load Setup

* Manage spot quote requests by submitting them to the quoting team or through automated quoting tools.
* Build accurate loads with complete customer, rate, pickup, delivery, and appointment details.
* Confirm all load information is complete and aligned with customer requirements.

Load Board and Coverage Management

* Monitor load board activity and ensure customer freight is covered in a timely manner.
* Identify and follow up on uncovered, delayed, or at-risk loads.
* Maintain accurate load status updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.

Customer and Carrier Service

* Serve as a primary contact for customer and carrier questions, updates, and appointment scheduling.
* Help carriers obtain missing information needed to complete pickups and deliveries.
* Communicate proactively and resolve routine service issues while escalating more complex concerns appropriately.

Problem Solving and Escalation

* Investigate and resolve shipment issues, including missing pickup numbers, appointment challenges, and documentation gaps.
* Partner with carrier operations and internal teams to keep freight moving and address service disruptions.
* Escalate significant incidents and maintain clear documentation through final resolution.

Service and Scorecard Management

* Review customer scorecards and verify the accuracy of service data, including on-time pickup and delivery performance.
* Reconcile scorecard information, revenue figures, and other key metrics with internal system data.
* Identify discrepancies, coordinate corrections, and support continuous improvement based on performance trends.

Accounts Receivable and Account Support

* Monitor account aging and assist with follow-up on outstanding receivables.
* Partner with customers and Finance to resolve billing, payment, and account-related issues.
* Maintain accurate account, revenue, and shipment records while supporting additional account management activities.

**You’ve Got This?**

* Experience in third-party logistics, freight brokerage, transportation, customer service, or account management preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple loads, customers, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-through abilities.

Posting Description:

**Surety Account Manager III**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor & negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power-of-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and facilitates data integrity and enabling proactive management of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to build and maintain accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). It also confirms and manages client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to avoid E&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking skills, consistently managing high-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision-making.

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Innovation
jobs.description:
**ABOUT OLIPOP**

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

new_jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Surgical Republic | On-site — Southern California**

**About the role:**

Surgical Republic supplies surgical instruments, disposables and implants to hospitals and surgery centers. We are seeking an organized, reliable Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to manage supplier orders and move products accurately from receiving through customer delivery.

You will order from approved U.S. and international suppliers, maintain inventory records, pack and ship orders, and follow up on delays. Our customer-service team handles instrument cross-referencing and provides the approved product specifications and part numbers.

**Responsibilities:**

Purchasing and supplier follow-up

* Place purchase orders using approved suppliers, part numbers, quantities and spending limits.
* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

Inventory and receiving

* Receive deliveries and verify products, quantities and condition against purchase orders.
* Record receipts, stock movements and storage locations accurately.
* Maintain an organized, clearly labeled inventory area.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor approved stock levels and submit replenishment needs.
* Track trial/demo instruments, returns and outstanding loaned inventory.

Order fulfillment

* Pick, check and pack the correct products and quantities.
* Prepare packing slips, shipping labels and required documents.
* Schedule carrier pickups and record tracking information.
* Coordinate partial shipments and backorders with customer service.
* Process approved returns and report damaged or incorrect items.

Order tracking and communication

* Keep the shared order tracker current, including supplier confirmations, delivery dates, blockers and shipment status.
* Notify customer service promptly when an order’s promised date is at risk.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

**How you will work with the team:**

* Hassan, Customer Service: Provides cross-referenced products and approved part numbers; handles customer communication.
* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

**What success looks like:**

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in our local office. This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will be able to support your Account Executives/Account Managers by generating and processing contracts, proposals, and presentations that enable Intersection to scale rapidly
* You will gain exposure and have daily communication with our Clients/Agencies
* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries
* You will own the pre-sale lifecycle of a contract: initial market research to contract creation and execution, to artwork / specification requests, track production process
* You will research and document competitive requests
* Develop a reputation for being a solid resource and will develop the foundational knowledge of our business model and the various media products and assets
* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

**You're a great fit for this role because:**

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution
* You have 1-2+ years relevant work experience in a customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization
* You can multi-task a number of different items
* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task
* You demonstrate a high level of accountability for both your work and the work of your team
* You have strong attention to detail and can spot and fix errors
* You work fast but thoughtfully, and make suggestions for efficiencies along the way
* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

Total Cash compensation: $50,000 - $55,000

### **Hybrid Work Policy**

Our team operates on a hybrid schedule to balance flexibility with face-to-face collaboration. We require all employees to be in the office every Tuesday and Wednesday. Please note that starting in September, this requirement will transition to three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with the flexibility to work remotely for the remainder of the week.

*At Intersection we celebrate every voice that makes us unique and every perspective that makes us grow. It’s our shared responsibility to create an equitable environment where every employee contributes to the culture of the company. **ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**SUMMARY**

The Research Coordinator supports the daily research and administrative operations of the laboratory. The position coordinates purchasing, vendor orders, supply inventory, specimen receipt and shipping, laboratory database records, scheduling, communications, and general laboratory maintenance. The Research Coordinator provides administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager and facilitates research-related interactions with collaborators within the Institute and outside centers.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support general research laboratory activities and routine administrative functions.
* Order laboratory supplies and materials; monitor order status; receive vendor items; verify deliveries; and follow up with vendors regarding delays, discrepancies, returns, or other order issues.
* Maintain laboratory supply inventory, monitor stock levels, organize storage areas, and coordinate replenishment to support daily operations.
* Monitor and coordinate the receipt, documentation, routing, storage, and shipment of specimens and research materials received from or sent to outside centers.
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate laboratory item, specimen, inventory, and research data in Microsoft databases and other approved systems.
* Provide administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager, including maintaining records, preparing routine documents, monitoring follow-up items, and assisting with program activities.
* Answer telephone calls, route inquiries, and deliver accurate and timely messages to laboratory members.
* Coordinate the Director’s calendar and meetings, including scheduling, invitations, room or virtual-meeting arrangements, materials, and related communications.
* Organize general laboratory maintenance activities, service requests, shared-space needs, and communications with internal service departments and external vendors.
* Maintain organized administrative, purchasing, inventory, shipping, specimen, and laboratory records in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate research-related communications and interactions with collaborators within the Institute and at external research centers.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of laboratory and research program needs.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in one of the biological sciences or a closely related field required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* More than three (3) years of experience supporting general research laboratory activities and related administrative tasks.
* More than two (2) years of experience in a laboratory administration position.
* Experience ordering, monitoring, and receiving vendor items and communicating with vendors regarding laboratory orders.
* Experience maintaining laboratory supply inventories and supporting general laboratory operations and maintenance activities.
* Experience monitoring and documenting the receipt and shipment of outside specimens or research materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft applications and databases used to manage laboratory items, specimens, inventory, and research data.
* Demonstrated ability to provide administrative support, coordinate calendars and meetings, handle telephone calls and messages, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow tasks through completion.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work professionally with laboratory personnel, leadership, vendors, and internal and external research collaborators.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with laboratory purchasing, inventory, specimen-tracking, shipping, or research-administration systems.
* Experience supporting a research director, principal investigator, program manager, or multidisciplinary research team.
* Experience coordinating with institutional departments, vendors, and external research centers.

Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

  

**Title:** Account Manager - Consumer

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA

  

**The Opportunity**

The **Account Manager** plays a critical role in driving revenue for the Consumer Care business unit. The Account Manager is responsible for promoting Galderma’s consumer skincare portfolio products (including Cetaphil), services to Health Care Providers (HCPs) and other offer key office staff members in order to create increased product demand within assigned territory.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, organize and execute field-based product promotion activities in accordance with all applicable company and regulatory standards to increase patient demand of consumer skincare portfolio through targeted strategies at the HCP office level
* Participate in face-to-face sales calls with HCPs (healthcare professionals), distribution of product samples, and attendance at company/company sponsored meetings; some meetings may occur during evening or weekend hours; travel may be necessary
* Meet or exceed goals and objectives for designated product portfolio and other KPIs (key performance indicators) such as HCP satisfaction surveys, coupon redemption, POS, etc. within assigned territory
    
  Utilize sales tools, resources, and supporting analysis to identify trends and to effectively identify and execute action plans
* Record sales call notes, tracking samples, and other territory management activities through company data reporting system; other administrative duties may be assigned
* Manage appropriate utilization of resources such as budget, samples, and peer to peer programs to engage and create impact with healthcare professionals.
* Work within given geography to develop relationships with providers and their staff
* Attend medical meetings/conferences as needed based on organization and regional needs
Other duties may be assigned  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from four-year College or university is required
* Two (2) years of outside business to business sales experience preferred
* Demonstrate strong track record of consistent documented success (such as sales performance)
* Possess valid driver’s license with clean driving record
* Ability to travel overnight as needed is required
* Strong business acumen including excellent communication (verbal/written), interpersonal, and persuasive skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships, service the total office, and add value with every interaction
Proficient with MS Office in a Windows environment, virtual interaction technology, and familiar with CRM software  

  

**Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is determined based on several factors. These include but are not limited to job accountabilities; skill sets; experience and training; certifications; work location; competitive market rates and other business needs. At Galderma, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on a unique combination of factors for each role. A reasonable estimate of the hiring range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000.

  

In addition to base salary, we provide an opportunity to participate in a competitive commission plan. We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program including health insurance, 401(k) plan with employer match, a generous paid time off policy, hybrid work schedules and more.

  

**Benefits**

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

  

**Work Authorization**

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

  

**What We Offer**  
At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

  

**Next Steps**

* If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
* The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team

new_jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Innovation
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT OLIPOP**

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

**Role Overview**

The Innovation Project Manager is the operational backbone of the Innovation team, translating ideas and priorities into clear plans, coordinated workstreams, and successful execution.

This role owns project timelines, team tools, cross-functional communication, and operational processes across the innovation pipeline, working independently to keep complex, fast-moving work on track. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and energized by bringing structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving work.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project & Pipeline Management

* Own project plans, timelines, milestones, and action logs for innovation initiatives from concept through launch.

* Lead cross-functional execution across Innovation, Commercial, Science & Medical Affairs, R&D, Brand, Insights, Commercialization, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Sales aligning partners on priorities, owners, and next steps.

* Anticipate risks and dependencies before they affect timing, develop mitigation plans, and escalate only when leadership decisions are needed.

* Own the innovation pipeline tools and launch calendar as the single source of truth for stakeholders.

* Lead and present monthly pipeline updates, highlighting key milestones, changes, risks, and recommended actions.

Team Operations

* Lead weekly Innovation Operations meetings: set agendas, drive decisions, and hold owners accountable for follow-through.

* Build and manage a team dashboard that gives leadership clear visibility into project status, priorities, and risks.

* Assess team capacity and competing priorities, recommend trade-offs, and propose priorities for VP approval.

* Manage the innovation project budget, including vendor costs and POs, and flag variances with recommended adjustments.

* Identify opportunities to improve how the team works, and design scalable templates, trackers, and workflows that are adopted across the team.

Business Support

* Develop and present materials for executive meetings and Stage Gate reviews, building clear narratives that support decision-making.

* Synthesize complex project information into concise updates, clear recommendations, and decision points for senior stakeholders.

* Lead research, competitive assessments, and launch-readiness activities for priority business needs.

* Build a working understanding of OLIPOP's innovation strategy, category trends, and competitive landscape to inform planning and recommendations.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Innovation projects have clear plans, owners, milestones, and next steps.

* Risks and dependencies are identified early and communicated clearly.

* Stakeholders have reliable visibility to the innovation pipeline.

* Meetings are focused, productive, and followed by consistent action.

* Cross-functional partners feel informed, supported, and clear on expectations.

* Team processes become more efficient without creating unnecessary complexity.

  

**Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in project management, Commercialization, Innovation, Marketing operations, or a related field.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple workstreams.

* Proven track record of independently leading cross-functional projects from planning through delivery.

* Sound judgment in balancing speed, risk, and impact, with the ability to work independently and with minimal guidance.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting confidently to senior and cross-functional audiences.

* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

* Experience in consumer pack

**Built on service. Powered by people.**
========================================

Impact exists because a small group of industry leaders believed companies in our space were doing it wrong. Many prioritized margins while the people doing the work and the clients relying on it became an afterthought. Impact was built differently: invest in great people, trust them to do great work, and deliver the kind of service clients remember. That approach helped us grow from a small office technology company into a national managed services provider, while remaining privately owned and people-first.

What makes Impact special is that growth has never come at the expense of the values that got us here. We continue to reinvest in our people, our capabilities, and the opportunities ahead so employees can grow alongside the business. We’ve built something special, but we’re far from finished. The people who join Impact now will help define what comes next.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients to generate pipeline for the sales organization. This role focuses on outbound and inbound prospecting, initiating executive-level conversations, and positioning Impact’s technology and managed services solutions to address business challenges. The ideal candidate is consultative, metric-driven, and thrives in a fast-paced sales environment. This position partners closely with Account Executives to drive revenue growth and market expansion.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Prospect and qualify new business opportunities through outbound calling, email, and sales engagement platforms
* Initiate and secure meetings with VP- and C-level decision makers while advancing Director-level conversations to executive stakeholders
* Generate a consistent volume of completed and qualified sales meetings to support monthly pipeline targets
* Conduct discovery conversations to uncover business challenges and align Impact solutions to prospect needs
* Collaborate with assigned Account Executives to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities
* Maintain accurate and timely activity, notes, and follow-ups within the CRM system
* Leverage intent data, sales intelligence, and sequencing tools to drive targeted outreach
* Build and nurture professional relationships through consistent, value-driven follow-up communication

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Experience in sales development, business development, or outbound lead generation
* Proven experience with outbound cold calling and high-volume prospecting activity
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage executive audiences
* Experience using CRM systems and sales engagement platforms such as Salesforce, SalesLoft, Outreach, or similar tools
* Ability to understand and articulate business challenges across multiple industries
* Familiarity with IT services, cybersecurity, digital transformation, or technology solutions preferred
* Self-motivated, results-oriented professional with the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment
* Experience leveraging intent data or sales intelligence platforms for targeted outreach is a plus

**What Drives Impact**
----------------------

Behaviors define what our core values look like in action. Leaders are expected to model them; teams are expected to live them:

* Innovation: We embrace change because innovation lives outside the comfort zone.
* Passion: We are driven by purpose, fueled by passion, and obsessed with making an impact.
* Honesty: We are fiercely transparent and consistently honest.
* Fun: We fuel work with fun, knowing life's too short for boring.
* Low Ego: We champion ideas over titles, because brilliance knows no rank.
* One Team: We win as a team, we lose as a team, we are one team.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager, Product Innovation
new_jobs.description:
**CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD**

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As the Assistant Brand Manager, Product Innovation you will help shape Chipotle’s menu innovation and go-to-market strategy by identifying new opportunities grounded in consumer insights, emerging food trends, culture, and the competitive landscape. You will actively seek out innovation pathways, staying close to what’s happening across food, culture, social media, and emerging brands to identify ideas, ingredients, formats, and partners that could unlock what’s next for Chipotle. You will partner closely with Culinary and cross-functional teams to help bring new menu items and market launches from concept to execution, supporting strategic product briefs, test markets, pricing, merchandising, and integrated marketing activation. This role will help ensure new products and launches deliver a compelling, socially relevant and consistent consumer experience across restaurants and digital channels.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Assess and identify opportunities and bring forward innovation ideas inspired by competitive landscape, emerging consumer behaviors, ingredients, cuisines, formats, brands, and cultural trends.
* Identify potential external partners and collaborators that can unlock differentiated innovation, accelerate development, or give Chipotle a relevant way into emerging cultural and food moments
* Support the development of strategic product briefs that translate consumer and business insights into clear direction for Chipotle’s Culinary team.
* Recommend timing and strategy for new menu items and support product development from concept through test market and national launch, including merchandising, pricing, and activation.
* Support new market launches by developing consumer insight-driven go-to-market strategies and briefs and coordinating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless consumer experience across restaurant and digital channels.
* Partner with internal and external communications and marketing teams, including creative agencies, experiential, social media, and digital partners, to develop and execute integrated go-to-market launch campaigns.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or Business from 4-year college or university
* 4+ years of relevant work experience in Brand Management experience in CPG products or Food industries with a demonstrated ability to support key organizational initiatives at a consumer-centric organization.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $99,000.00–$138,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. new_jobs.title: Digital Delivery Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.
* Experience building reporting packages or KPI dashboards for an executive audience.

new_jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $20/hr
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

new_jobs.title: School Event Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Flexible schedule
* Home office stipend
* Opportunity for advancement

**We Offer**

* Tutu school onboarding and online training
* Sick pay provided
* Positive company culture
* Additional perks are available!

**Job Summary**  
At Tutu School, we look for magic makers. On our team, we want hearts that never stop twirling and minds that thrive on creativity. We require our teachers to have a strong background in dance, great communication skills, and a commitment to our carefully crafted curriculum. Most of all, we want instructors who are invested in nurturing the big dreams of little dancers.However, this position is unique. We are looking for someone to manage, organize, and host monthly events and birthday parties at our two locations: Burlingame and San Bruno.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, host, manage, organize monthly themed parties, as well as, any booked birthday parties following Tutu School's carefully crafted Class Curriculum.
* Take attendance and answer basic questions about class membership and promotions.
* Build rapport and communication with students' families and prospective clients.
* Perform basic retail duties including product restocking and processing sales using a point-of-sale system.
* Maintain organization and cleanliness of the studio, lobby, retail display, and bathroom.
* Communicate effectively with management and administration.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in dancing with a ballet background is strongly preferred
* High school or equivalent is preferred
* Teaching experience is preferred

**About Tutu School**

* Tutu School is a collection of quaint boutique ballet schools that provides a creative dance education experience for children from 6 months to 8 years old.
* It is a place where students are urged to fully exercise their imaginations as well as their bodies, and where we not only focus on teaching children age-appropriate motor skills and the fundamental principles of ballet but also expose them to the world of classical music and the enchanting stories of famous ballets.

**Our Founding Principle**

* Every child should know what it feels like to dance. We exist to make space in children’s lives for confident creativity and the pure joy that comes from finding oneself in music and movement.

**Tutu Principles**

* **Keep Moving**: Keep dancing. Keep twirling. Keep going. Momentum doesn’t generate itself.
* **Exceed Expectations**: Tutu School families have high expectations. We want to leap over them.
* **Mistakes Happen**: Own them. Understand them. Grow from them.
* **Remember Why**: Tutu School exists to make space in the world for creativity and joy.
* **Next Right Thing**: Find it. Follow it. One right thing at a time.
* **Find The Magic**: Always. In everything you do.

*All Tutu School® locations are independently owned and operated by third-party franchisees. Franchisees, not Tutu School Franchises, LLC., are responsible for all hiring and personnel matters at their individual locations.*

new_jobs.title: Event & Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing - they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce - where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Event & Community Manager based in Palo Alto to own our West Coast events. This is the founding role for our West Coast events program: you'll build it across the Bay Area and Los Angeles from the ground up, with no existing playbook to inherit and full ownership over how it takes shape. You'll design and run the experiences that bring our customers, prospects, and industry community together, from intimate dinners and executive roundtables to conference presence. You'll also help grow Nectar's community alongside the broader marketing team.

The Bay Area is home base. From Palo Alto to San Francisco, it's where we connect with tech founders, investors, and B2B operators. Los Angeles is where we show up for consumer brands, creators, and agencies. You'll split your time between both and make Nectar a known name in each.

You'll report directly to the marketing leadership team and work closely with sales, customer success, and the founders to make sure every event and community touchpoint ladders up to pipeline, retention, and brand.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Events**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution for Nectar's West Coast event calendar across SF and LA: customer dinners, executive roundtables, happy hours, creator meetups, and conference sponsorships and booths.
* Run account-based event programs with sales: executive dinners and roundtables built around target accounts, with a follow-up plan for every attendee.
* Build a recurring event series in both cities so Nectar has a consistent, recognizable presence in each market.
* Manage budgets, vendors, venues, and logistics in both cities, and build repeatable processes so events scale smoothly as the company grows.
* Partner with sales and customer success on event strategies that generate pipeline and deepen relationships with existing customers.
* Track and report on event ROI (attendance, sourced and influenced pipeline, and customer sentiment), and use that data to sharpen the calendar over time.
* Represent Nectar at West Coast industry conferences and manage on-site logistics, staffing, and sponsor deliverables.

### **Community**

* Support the launch and growth of Nectar's customer and industry community program (e.g., a Slack community, ambassador program, or customer council).
* Help run the content and engagement cadence that keeps the community active: AMAs, office hours, member spotlights, and peer-to-peer discussion.
* Use in-person events to feed the community, turning SF and LA attendees into active members.
* Build authentic relationships with key West Coast customers, creators, and industry voices.
* Identify and cultivate community advocates who can support case studies, referrals, and word-of-mouth growth.
* Feed community insights and feedback back to the product, marketing, and customer success teams.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5-8 years of experience in B2B event marketing, community management, or a hybrid of both, with most of it at B2B SaaS companies.
* A track record of running B2B field and executive events end-to-end, from concept through post-event reporting, that sourced and accelerated pipeline alongside sales.
* Fluency in B2B event measurement: campaign attribution in HubSpot or Salesforce, sourced versus influenced pipeline, and post-event follow-up with target accounts.
* Experience supporting or growing an online or in-person community.
* Based in or near Palo Alto, with working knowledge of the Bay Area and LA event scenes: the venues, the vendors, and the people worth knowing.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in an early-stage environment where processes don't exist yet. You're excited to build them.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple events across two markets without dropping details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a real interest in connecting with people.
* Willingness to travel regularly to San Francisco, Los Angeles, and industry conferences (estimated 20-30%).

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in the social media, marketing technology, or creator economy space.
* Experience marketing to brand, social, or marketing leaders as the buyer.
* An existing network in Bay Area tech and in LA's consumer brand or creator communities.
* Familiarity with community platforms (Slack, Discord, Circle) and event tools (Luma, Bizzabo, HubSpot).
* Prior experience as an early hire at a startup, building a function from zero to one.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and early equity
* Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match
* ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes
* $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees

**For our Palo Alto Office:**

* Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)
* Free lunch in the heart of University
